For the 1968 demonstration, the team utilized custom modems, microwave video transmission, and audio return lines to connect the San Francisco venue with the SRI lab. Over 1,000 attendees witnessed unprecedented actions like clicking a mouse to navigate links, though few realized they were looking at the blueprint for the next 50 years of computing. Throughout his life, Engelbart felt that Silicon Valley had appropriated his ideas without proper credit; for instance, when Apple famously visited Xerox PARC in 1979 to view the Alto, the graphical user interface concepts they observed were deeply rooted in Engelbart's original NLS framework.
events.why_it_matters_en: This demonstration effectively defined human-computer interaction as an independent discipline. Concepts like the mouse, hyperlinks, and collaborative editing were later commercialized by Apple, Microsoft, and Tim Berners-Lee in the 1980s and 1990s, forming the foundation of all modern desktop and mobile devices. Furthermore, Engelbart's overarching philosophy of "Intelligence Amplification" (IA)—using technology to augment human intellect rather than replace it—has regained prominence in the era of large language models. Contemporary tools like Notion AI, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot are direct continuations of the visionary framework Engelbart first proposed in 1968.

events.title_zh: SRI Shakey:第一个会推理的移动机器人
events.title_en: Shakey: First Mobile Robot with Reasoning
events.summary_zh:
1966-1972 年，SRI International(Charles Rosen + Nils Nilsson 团队）开发 Shakey——第一个能感知环境、规划路径、执行动作的自主移动机器人。
1969 年第一版完成：装电视摄像头、激光测距仪、碰撞传感器，通过无线连到 DEC PDP-10/PDP-15 上跑规划与感知。
1971-1972 年 Fikes+Nilsson 发表 STRIPS 规划器，把“动作 = 前提条件 + 删除表 + 添加表”形式化，成为之后 30 年机器人规划的事实标准。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Shakey 名字来自它走起来“摇摇晃晃”——顶上摄像头太重，移动时常停顿。
项目 1963 年由 Charles Rosen 提议,1965 年向 DARPA 提交计划书，拿到 75 万美元（相当于今天 580 万；金额待核实),1966 年正式启动。
1969 年第一次完整演示时，Shakey 已经能在房间里独立完成“找到物体并推走”的任务，被《Life》杂志称为“第一个电子人”。
Nilsson 后来回忆:“我们以为 10 年内会有家用机器人，结果这条路走了 50 年还没走完。”
events.why_it_matters_zh:
Shakey 同时贡献了 A* 搜索、Hough 变换、可见性图、STRIPS、分层架构——这些是今天所有移动机器人（扫地机、自动驾驶、火星车、仓储机器人）的算法基石。
2004 年 Shakey 入选卡内基梅隆机器人名人堂。
OpenAI 2020 年代的机器人研究、Waymo 路径规划，依然在用 STRIPS 的变体。
events.source_name: Nilsson, N. J. (1984). Shakey the Robot. SRI AI Center Technical Note 323.
events.card_summary_zh: Shakey 把感知、规划和行动装进同一台移动机器人，第一次让机器根据环境自主决定下一步。
events.card_summary_en: SRI International's Shakey integrated perception, planning, and action into a single mobile robot, marking the first time a machine could autonomously determine its next steps based on its environment.
events.summary_en: Between 1966 and 1972, a team at SRI International led by Charles Rosen and Nils Nilsson developed Shakey, the first autonomous mobile robot capable of perceiving its environment, planning paths, and executing actions. The first complete version, finished in 1969, featured a television camera, a laser rangefinder, and bump sensors. It connected wirelessly to DEC PDP-10 and PDP-15 computers to run its perception and planning algorithms. In 1971, Richard Fikes and Nils Nilsson published the STRIPS planner, which formalized actions using preconditions, delete lists, and add lists, establishing the de facto standard for automated planning over the next three decades.
events.context_en: The robot earned the name "Shakey" due to its jerky, wobbling movements; its heavy top-mounted camera caused it to frequently pause and shudder while navigating. Charles Rosen initially proposed the project in 1963 and submitted a proposal to DARPA in 1965, securing $750,000 in funding (a figure reported to be equivalent to roughly $5.8 million today, though historical inflation estimates vary). The project officially launched in 1966. By its first full demonstration in 1969, Shakey could independently navigate a room to locate and push objects, prompting Life magazine to dub it the "first electronic person." The project's early success generated immense optimism about the future of embodied AI. Nils Nilsson later reflected on this initial enthusiasm, noting that the team believed household robots were less than a decade away—a trajectory that ultimately took more than half a century and remains an ongoing challenge in robotics today.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Shakey project yielded a foundational breakthrough in artificial intelligence, simultaneously contributing the A* search algorithm, the Hough transform, visibility graphs, the STRIPS planner, and layered control architectures. These innovations remain the algorithmic bedrock for virtually all modern mobile robots, from household vacuum cleaners and warehouse logistics robots to autonomous vehicles and Mars rovers. Inducted into the Carnegie Mellon Robot Hall of Fame in 2004, Shakey's legacy endures across the industry. Even in the 2020s, advanced robotics research at organizations like OpenAI and path-planning systems developed by companies like Waymo continue to utilize modern variants of the STRIPS architecture.

events.title_zh: Minsky-Papert《Perceptrons》:神经网络第一次大挫折
events.title_en: Minsky and Papert Publish Perceptrons, Triggering the First Major Setback for Neural Networks
events.summary_zh:
1969 年，Marvin Minsky 和 Seymour Papert 出版《Perceptrons: An Introduction to Computational Geometry》(MIT Press)。
书中用严格数学证明：单层感知机无法表达 XOR、连通性等基本函数，要表达这些函数必须靠多层网络，而多层网络当时没有可用的训练算法。
1988 年扩展版（含 Epilogue）承认原版部分论断被过度外推——但 1969 年原版引发的“神经网络死路”印象已经形成，直接促成 1970 年代第一次 AI 寒冬。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Minsky 和 Papert 写这本书时，Rosenblatt 是他们的同行朋友。
书中确实没有“杀死神经网络”的明文，但 1969 年第一版的最后一章用了大量“perceptron 不会…”的句式，加上 MIT Press 营销，使公众印象变成“AI 学界宣布神经网络已死”。
Papert 后来承认:“我们想写一本严谨的书，结果变成一颗炸弹。” Rosenblatt 没等到为自己辩护——1971 年 7 月在他 43 岁生日当天划船遇难。
他死后的 5 年里，全美神经网络研究经费下降 90%（比例待核实)。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
这是 AI 史上被引用最多、误读最多的一本书。
原书只讨论单层感知机，但被读成“所有神经网络都不行”,导致 1970-1980 年代神经网络研究资金枯竭，研究者转行。
Rosenblatt 1971 年划船事故去世时，他的多层感知机研究已无人接续。
直到 1986 年 Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams 反向传播论文才打破这个误读;2024 年 Hinton 拿诺贝尔奖，依然在采访中提及这本书对他的影响。
events.source_name: Minsky, M. & Papert, S. (1969). Perceptrons. MIT Press.
events.card_summary_zh: Minsky-Papert《Perceptrons》：神经网络第一次大挫折；是 AI 史上被引用最多、误读最多的一本书。
events.card_summary_en: Marvin Minsky and Seymour Papert published Perceptrons, delivering the first major setback to neural network research. It remains one of the most cited and widely misinterpreted books in AI history.
events.summary_en: Marvin Minsky and Seymour Papert published Perceptrons: An Introduction to Computational Geometry through MIT Press. The book provided rigorous mathematical proofs demonstrating that single-layer perceptrons could not compute basic functions like XOR or connectedness. While the authors noted that multi-layer networks could overcome these limitations, no viable training algorithms existed at the time. Although a 1988 expanded edition acknowledged that some original claims were over-extrapolated, the 1969 publication had already cemented the impression that neural networks were a dead end, directly contributing to the first AI winter in the 1970s.
events.context_en: When Marvin Minsky and Seymour Papert wrote the book, Frank Rosenblatt—the inventor of the perceptron—was their peer and friend. The text did not explicitly declare neural networks dead, but the final chapter of the 1969 edition relied heavily on definitive phrasing about what perceptrons "will not" do. Combined with marketing efforts by MIT Press, the public takeaway was that the AI academic establishment had pronounced the field dead. Papert later admitted, "We wanted to write a rigorous book, and it turned out to be a bomb." Tragically, Rosenblatt did not live long enough to fully defend his work; he died in a boating accident on his 43rd birthday in July 1971. In the five years following his death, funding for neural network research in the United States plummeted—with some estimates suggesting a drop of up to 90%, though the exact proportion still needs verification.
events.why_it_matters_en: Perceptrons remains one of the most cited and widely misinterpreted books in the history of artificial intelligence. Although the original text strictly analyzed single-layer perceptrons, it was broadly interpreted as proof that all neural networks were fundamentally flawed. This misunderstanding dried up research funding throughout the 1970s and 1980s, forcing many researchers to abandon the field. Following Rosenblatt’s death in 1971, his work on multi-layer perceptrons was largely left without a successor. The prevailing skepticism was not definitively broken until the 1986 backpropagation paper by Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams. Decades later, when Geoffrey Hinton won the Nobel Prize in 2024, he still cited the profound historical impact of Minsky and Papert's book during his interviews.

events.title_zh: 第一次 AI 寒冬:英美同步降温
events.title_en: First AI Winter Begins
events.summary_zh:
1973-1974 年，英美 AI 经费同步大砍，构成第一次 AI 寒冬。
英国:Lighthill 报告（1973）导致 SRC 停止对爱丁堡之外多数大学的 AI 资助。
美国:DARPA 1969 年 Mansfield 修正案后必须证明项目“直接军事相关”,1971-1974 年大幅削减 CMU、MIT、SRI、斯坦福的 AI 通用研究经费,1974 年的 DARPA AI 研究预算比 1968 年下降约 30%。
学术界:Minsky 与 Papert《Perceptrons》（1969）被误读为“神经网络已死”,连接主义研究在 70 年代几乎断流。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
寒冬不是单点事件，而是三股力量叠加。
技术层：机器翻译、机器视觉、语音识别都没达到 60 年代承诺的水平，组合爆炸让通用问题求解器在真实问题上跑不动。
经济层:1973 年石油危机 + 美国经济衰退，政府研究预算全面收紧。
机构层:DARPA 不再容忍“纯科学好奇”,要求项目有可交付的军事价值。
三股力叠加，把 AI 从“明天的明星”压成“过度承诺的失败品”。
学生停止报考，教授转行，这一波寒冬一直延续到 1980 年专家系统复苏。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
第一次寒冬是 AI 史最完整的“承诺-现实-惩罚”循环样本。
理解它，就能理解为什么 Hinton、LeCun 这一代人在 90 年代坚持神经网络会被认为是“固执到不可理喻”。
也能理解 2023 年后生成式 AI 泡沫论里“寒冬要来了”的恐惧从何而来。
AI 的历史从来不是单向进步，而是“过热 - 寒冬 - 复苏”的循环。
events.source_name: Crevier, G. (1993). AI: The Tumultuous History; McCorduck 2004; Russell & Norvig 3rd ed.
events.card_summary_zh: 承诺远超实际能力后，英美资助机构同时收紧经费，AI 第一次为过度乐观付出整个行业的代价。
events.card_summary_en: After early promises far exceeded actual capabilities, US and UK funding agencies simultaneously slashed budgets, marking the first time the AI industry paid a systemic price for its over-optimism.
events.summary_en: Between 1973 and 1974, synchronized funding cuts in the US and UK triggered the first AI Winter. In the UK, the 1973 Lighthill Report led the Science Research Council to halt AI funding for most universities outside Edinburgh. In the US, the 1969 Mansfield Amendment required DARPA to fund only projects with direct military relevance. Consequently, DARPA drastically reduced general AI research funding at CMU, MIT, SRI, and Stanford, with its 1974 AI budget dropping roughly 30% compared to 1968. Meanwhile, Minsky and Papert's *Perceptrons* (1969) was widely misinterpreted as a death knell for neural networks, nearly halting connectionist research throughout the 1970s.
events.context_en: The first AI Winter was not an isolated event but the convergence of three distinct forces. Technologically, machine translation, computer vision, and speech recognition failed to meet the lofty promises made in the 1960s, while combinatorial explosion prevented general problem solvers from scaling to real-world tasks. Economically, the 1973 oil crisis and the ensuing US recession led to across-the-board contractions in government research budgets. Institutionally, DARPA lost patience with pure scientific curiosity, demanding projects with deliverable military value instead. Together, these pressures transformed AI from a promising frontier into a symbol of over-promising and under-delivering. Students stopped enrolling in AI programs, and professors shifted their focus to other disciplines. This deep freeze persisted until the commercial resurgence of expert systems in the early 1980s.
events.why_it_matters_en: The first AI Winter serves as the most complete historical example of the hype cycle in artificial intelligence, moving from outsized promises to harsh reality and systemic punishment. Understanding this period explains why researchers like Geoffrey Hinton and Yann LeCun were later viewed as unreasonably stubborn for persisting with neural networks during subsequent downturns. It also contextualizes the persistent fears of a looming winter amid debates over generative AI bubbles in the 2020s. The history of AI has never been a trajectory of uninterrupted progress, but rather a recurring cycle of over-optimism, disillusionment, and eventual recovery.

events.title_zh: Werbos 反向传播:深度学习的数学起点
events.title_en: Werbos Backpropagation: Beyond Regression (1974 Harvard PhD)
events.summary_zh:
1974 年 8 月，Paul Werbos 在哈佛大学通过博士论文答辩，题目《Beyond Regression: New Tools for Prediction and Analysis in the Behavioral Sciences》。
论文第二章首次完整提出用链式法则从输出端往输入端反推偏导，在多层复合函数里“一次正向 + 一次反向”算出所有参数的梯度，并明确指出这套方法可以训练多层神经网络。
这是 backpropagation 算法在西方文献中的首次完整描述。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Werbos 1974 答辩时，neural network 已是学术禁区。
Minsky 与 Papert《Perceptrons》1969 把这条路判了死刑，论文委员会里没人相信神经网络能再活过来。
Werbos 自己更多把这套数学当通用预测工具用，做过政治预测、能源模型。
直到 1986 年 Rumelhart、Hinton、Williams 在 Nature 重新独立提出 BP,并把名字固定为 backpropagation,Werbos 的 1974 论文才被回溯认领。
Werbos 后来说:Freud 1895 年《科学心理学方案》里其实已经描述过类似的反向学习信号。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
BP 是整个深度学习的训练算法基石。
今天 GPT、Claude、Gemini、Stable Diffusion、AlphaFold 的训练循环，本质上都是 Werbos 1974 论文里那次“正向算预测，反向算梯度，更新权重”。
理解 BP 在 1974 年被埋没 12 年，才能理解为什么 Hinton 这一代人把“不被理解”当成科研常态。
events.source_name: Werbos, P. (1974). Harvard PhD thesis; (1994) Wiley book The Roots of Backpropagation
events.card_summary_zh: 这是 backpropagation 算法在西方文献中的首次完整描述；BP 是整个深度学习的训练算法基石。
events.card_summary_en: Paul Werbos's Harvard PhD thesis provided the first complete description of the backpropagation algorithm in Western literature. This mathematical framework remains the foundational training algorithm for all modern deep learning.
events.summary_en: In August 1974, Paul Werbos successfully defended his Harvard PhD thesis, titled "Beyond Regression: New Tools for Prediction and Analysis in the Behavioral Sciences." The second chapter provided the first complete description of the backpropagation algorithm in Western literature. Werbos proposed using the chain rule to back-propagate partial derivatives from the output to the input. By executing one forward pass and one backward pass within multi-layer composite functions, his method could calculate the gradients for all parameters. Crucially, Werbos explicitly noted that this mathematical framework could be used to train multi-layer neural networks.
events.context_en: When Werbos defended his thesis in 1974, neural network research was largely considered an academic taboo. Marvin Minsky and Seymour Papert's 1969 book *Perceptrons* had effectively condemned the field, and no one on Werbos's dissertation committee believed neural networks could be revived. Consequently, Werbos primarily applied his mathematical framework as a general-purpose prediction tool, using it for political forecasting and energy modeling rather than artificial intelligence. His foundational work remained largely obscure for over a decade. It was not until 1986, when David Rumelhart, Geoffrey Hinton, and Ronald Williams independently reintroduced the algorithm in a landmark *Nature* paper and cemented the term "backpropagation," that Werbos's 1974 thesis was retrospectively recognized. Interestingly, Werbos later noted that Sigmund Freud's 1895 manuscript *Project for a Scientific Psychology* had actually described a conceptually similar backward-flowing learning signal.
events.why_it_matters_en: Backpropagation is the foundational training algorithm for the entire field of deep learning. The training loops powering today's most advanced AI systems—including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Stable Diffusion, and AlphaFold—are fundamentally executing the exact sequence outlined in Werbos's 1974 thesis: a forward pass to calculate predictions, a backward pass to compute gradients, and a subsequent weight update. Understanding how backpropagation was buried for 12 years highlights the historical context of neural network research, explaining why pioneers like Geoffrey Hinton spent decades treating academic skepticism and marginalization as the norm.

events.title_zh: MYCIN:专家系统进入医学诊断
events.title_en: MYCIN: Medical Expert System
events.summary_zh:
1974 年 10 月，Edward Shortliffe 在斯坦福提交博士论文《MYCIN: A Rule-Based Computer Program for Advising Physicians Regarding Antimicrobial Therapy Selection》（CS-TR-74-465, AIM-251）。
MYCIN 用 ~600 条产生式规则，把感染科医生判断菌血症、选抗生素的经验编码进 LISP 程序。
它最重要的一项创新是把确定性推理改造成“确定性因子（Certainty Factor)”,在规则之间传递部分置信度，这是当时不确定性推理的代表作。
1979 年 Yu 等人评估:MYCIN 的抗生素选择 65% 被专家评为可接受，高于 9 名人类住院医师的中位数（具体比例与对照人数待核实）。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
MYCIN 从来没真正进入临床使用。
原因不是性能，而是法律、责任、维护成本：出错了谁负责？规则库要随抗生素更新持续维护，谁来付钱？Shortliffe 自己后来反思，MYCIN 的真正贡献不是医学，而是给后续 EMYCIN(1979）、PROSPECTOR、XCON 等专家系统提供了模板：知识库 + 推理引擎 + 解释器三件套。
EMYCIN 还把“领域无关骨架”这个概念引入 AI,直接影响 80 年代专家系统产业。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
MYCIN 是 AI 落地医学的最早严肃尝试。
它把专家知识显式编码这条路走到极致，也暴露了“规则库维护成本爆炸”的死结。
今天基于大模型的临床辅助系统走的是统计路线，但“AI 在医学里到底负什么责”这个问题，MYCIN 时代就提出过，至今没完全解决。
events.source_name: Shortliffe, E. H. (1974). PhD thesis, Stanford CS-TR-74-465; (1975) Comput Biomed Res 8(4)
events.card_summary_zh: MYCIN 用数百条规则辅助诊断感染和选择抗生素，展示了专家知识如何被编码进一套可解释系统。
events.card_summary_en: MYCIN utilized hundreds of production rules to assist in diagnosing bacterial infections and selecting antibiotics, demonstrating how specialized human knowledge could be encoded into an interpretable artificial intelligence system.
events.summary_en: In October 1974, Edward Shortliffe submitted his Stanford PhD thesis introducing MYCIN, a LISP program that encoded infectious disease specialists' expertise into approximately 600 production rules for diagnosing bacteremia and recommending antibiotics. A major innovation was its use of "Certainty Factors," which allowed partial confidence levels to propagate between rules, making it a landmark in reasoning under uncertainty. A 1979 evaluation by Yu et al. found that experts rated 65% of MYCIN's antibiotic selections as acceptable, outperforming the median of nine human residents (though the exact proportions and control group size still need verification).
events.context_en: Despite its technical achievements, MYCIN was never actually deployed in clinical practice. The barriers were not related to performance, but rather to legal liability, accountability, and maintenance costs. Questions arose regarding who would be responsible if the system made a fatal error, and who would fund the continuous updates required to keep the rule base current with new antibiotics. Shortliffe later reflected that MYCIN's true contribution was not to medicine, but to computer science. It provided a foundational template—comprising a knowledge base, an inference engine, and an explanation facility—for subsequent expert systems like PROSPECTOR and XCON. Furthermore, it led to the development of EMYCIN (Essential MYCIN) in 1979, which stripped away the medical knowledge to create a "domain-independent skeleton." This concept of an empty expert system shell directly influenced the commercialization and expansion of the expert system industry throughout the 1980s.
events.why_it_matters_en: MYCIN represents one of the earliest serious attempts to apply artificial intelligence to medicine. By pushing the explicit encoding of expert knowledge to its limits, it successfully demonstrated the potential of rule-based systems while simultaneously exposing their fatal flaw: the explosive cost of maintaining complex rule bases. Today, clinical decision support systems powered by large language models rely on statistical approaches rather than explicit rules. However, the fundamental question raised during the MYCIN era—who bears ultimate responsibility when AI is used in medical settings—remains unresolved decades later.

events.title_zh: 物理符号系统假说:Newell & Simon Turing 演讲
events.title_en: Physical Symbol System Hypothesis (Newell & Simon 1975 Turing Lecture)
events.summary_zh:
1975 年 10 月 20 日，Allen Newell 和 Herbert A. Simon 在明尼阿波利斯 ACM 年会上联合接受 1975 年 ACM Turing Award,演讲题为《Computer Science as Empirical Inquiry:Symbols and Search》,1976 年 3 月发表于 CACM 19(3）。
演讲正式提出物理符号系统假说（PSSH):“一个物理符号系统具备产生一般智能行为的必要和充分手段”。
他们把过去 20 年 Logic Theorist、GPS、NSS 的工作总结为两条原则：智能 = 符号操作 + 启发式搜索。
这是符号主义 AI 最完整的纲领性陈述。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Simon 同时获得 1978 年诺贝尔经济学奖（有限理性),他是史上唯一既拿 Turing 又拿 Nobel 的人。
Newell 在演讲里特意强调“计算机科学是经验学科”,意思是 AI 不能只靠纯数学推导，而要造机器、写程序、做实验、看结果。
这个观点当时和 Dijkstra 的“计算机科学是数学”针锋相对，今天深度学习的“经验驱动研究范式”正是 Newell-Simon 路线的延续。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
PSSH 是符号主义的“宪法”。
它让 70-80 年代的 AI 研究把精力集中在搜索、知识表示、推理引擎上。
1985 年 Brooks《异形智能》一文开炮“没有表征的智能”,1990 年代连接主义复活,2010 年代深度学习爆发，都是对 PSSH 的反叛。
理解 PSSH,才能理解每一次 AI 范式革命到底在反对什么。
events.source_name: Newell, A. & Simon, H. A. (1976). CACM 19(3):113-126
events.card_summary_zh: 演讲正式提出物理符号系统假说（PSSH):“一个物理符号系统具备产生一般智能行为的必要和充分手段”；PSSH 是符号主义的“宪法”。
events.card_summary_en: The lecture formally introduced the Physical Symbol System Hypothesis (PSSH), asserting that such a system has the necessary and sufficient means for general intelligent action, becoming the foundational doctrine of symbolic AI.
events.summary_en: On October 20, 1975, Allen Newell and Herbert A. Simon jointly accepted the ACM Turing Award in Minneapolis. Their lecture, "Computer Science as Empirical Inquiry: Symbols and Search" (published in March 1976), formally introduced the Physical Symbol System Hypothesis (PSSH). The hypothesis posited that a physical symbol system possesses the necessary and sufficient means for general intelligent action. Synthesizing two decades of work on systems like the Logic Theorist and General Problem Solver, they distilled intelligence into two core principles: symbol manipulation and heuristic search. This address remains the most comprehensive programmatic statement of symbolic AI.
events.context_en: Herbert A. Simon later won the 1978 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for his work on bounded rationality, making him the only person in history to receive both a Turing Award and a Nobel Prize. In their lecture, Newell notably emphasized that computer science is an empirical discipline. He argued that AI research cannot rely solely on pure mathematical deduction; rather, it requires building machines, writing programs, conducting experiments, and observing results. This perspective stood in stark contrast to Edsger W. Dijkstra's contemporary view that computer science was fundamentally a branch of mathematics. Today, the heavily empirical, experiment-driven research paradigm of modern deep learning is, in many ways, a direct continuation of the methodological trajectory championed by Newell and Simon.
events.why_it_matters_en: PSSH served as the foundational constitution for symbolic AI, directing research throughout the 1970s and 1980s to focus heavily on heuristic search, knowledge representation, and inference engines. Subsequent paradigm shifts in AI can largely be understood as rebellions against this very hypothesis. Rodney Brooks's 1985 critique advocating for "intelligence without representation," the revival of connectionism in the 1990s, and the explosion of deep learning in the 2010s all challenged the necessity and sufficiency of explicit symbol manipulation. Understanding PSSH is therefore essential for grasping exactly what later AI revolutions were pushing back against.

events.title_zh: XCON/R1:专家系统首次大规模商用
events.title_en: XCON/R1: First Large-Scale Commercial Expert System
events.summary_zh:
1978-1980 年，John McDermott 在 CMU 为 DEC 公司开发 R1（后改名 XCON,eXpert CONfigurer）。
1980 年 4 月正式上线，任务是自动配置 VAX-11/780 计算机订单，把销售员勾选的硬件清单转成可投产的连接方案。
R1 用 OPS5 产生式规则编写，初始约 500 条规则，到 1986 年膨胀到上千至上万条。
DEC 报告每年节省约 2500 万美元，几乎消灭了订单配置错误。
XCON 是专家系统商业化时代的旗舰案例，直接催生 1981 年 DEC 内部 40+ 个专家系统项目，以及全球企业跟风上马专家系统的浪潮。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
XCON 的成功有其特定条件。
第一，配置 VAX 是高度结构化任务，规则边界清晰，没有“灰色判断”。
第二，DEC 自己的工程师就是领域专家，知识获取顺畅。
第三，订单量足够大，哪怕每次只省 5 分钟也回本。
这三个条件在其他行业（医疗、法律、勘探）几乎都不成立，所以 XCON 越成功，越让企业误以为专家系统可以无限复制，结果 1985 年之后大批公司上马专家系统失败，埋下第二次 AI 寒冬的种子。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
XCON 是 AI 史上第一次“真金白银回本”的工业级部署。
它证明 AI 能在企业里产生可量化的经济价值，而不仅是论文里的演示。
但它的成功条件被忽视，失败条件被低估，这种“成功案例 → 盲目跟风 → 集体崩盘”的剧本，在 2023-2025 年的 LLM 落地潮里再次上演。
events.source_name: McDermott, J. (1982). R1: A rule-based configurer of computer systems. Artificial Intelligence 19(1):39-88
events.card_summary_zh: XCON 自动配置复杂计算机订单，每年为 DEC 节省数千万美元，专家系统第一次真正实现大规模商业回报。
events.card_summary_en: XCON automated the configuration of complex computer orders, saving DEC tens of millions of dollars annually and marking the first time an expert system achieved large-scale commercial returns.
events.summary_en: Developed by John McDermott at Carnegie Mellon University for Digital Equipment Corporation (DEC), R1 (later renamed XCON) officially launched in April 1980. It automated the configuration of VAX-11/780 computer orders, translating sales checklists into production-ready assembly plans. Written in OPS5, XCON grew from about 500 initial rules to thousands by 1986. DEC reported annual savings of approximately $25 million and the near-elimination of configuration errors. As the flagship commercial expert system, XCON spurred over 40 similar internal projects at DEC by 1981 and triggered a global wave of enterprise adoption.
events.context_en: XCON’s success relied on highly specific conditions. First, configuring VAX systems was a highly structured task with clear rule boundaries and no need for nuanced or ambiguous judgments. Second, DEC’s own engineers served as the domain experts, making knowledge acquisition straightforward. Third, the order volume was large enough that saving even five minutes per configuration yielded a strong return on investment. These three conditions were rarely met in other industries, such as healthcare, law, or geological exploration. Consequently, the more successful XCON became, the more it misled other enterprises into believing that expert systems could be universally replicated. This misconception led to widespread project failures after 1985, ultimately planting the seeds for the second AI winter.
events.why_it_matters_en: XCON represented the first industrial-scale AI deployment to deliver tangible financial returns. It proved that AI could generate quantifiable economic value in an enterprise setting, moving beyond academic demonstrations. However, its specific prerequisites for success were widely ignored, while the conditions for failure were underestimated. This cycle—a flagship success story followed by blind imitation and eventual collective collapse—established a recurring pattern in AI commercialization, echoing decades later during the enterprise adoption wave of large language models from 2023 to 2025.

events.title_zh: Hopfield 网络:神经网络复苏的火花
events.title_en: Hopfield Network: Revival of Neural Networks
events.summary_zh:
1982 年 4 月，Caltech 物理学家 John Hopfield 在 PNAS 79(8):2554-2558 发表《Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities》。
他构造了一个对称全连接的二值神经元网络，并引入“能量函数”的概念，证明网络状态会沿能量梯度下降，最终收敛到吸引子（局部极小）。
把一个记忆存进网络 = 把吸引子刻进能量地形；给网络一个残缺输入 = 让小球滚回最近的洼地。
这一刻神经网络突然有了物理直觉，不再只是心理学模型。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Hopfield 报告的时机极其关键。
1982 年正值第一次 AI 寒冬尾声，神经网络在主流 AI 圈几乎被遗忘。
Hopfield 是物理学家，不是 AI 圈人，他的论文发表在 PNAS 而不是 AI 期刊，反而绕过了符号主义审稿人的偏见。
他后续 1984 年的连续 Hopfield 网络、1985 年与 Tank 的优化计算论文，把神经网络重新带回主流视野，直接为 1986 年 PDP 和反向传播铺路。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
Hopfield 网络本身不是工程主力，但它把“神经网络可以做计算”这件事重新摆回桌面。
没有 Hopfield 这一脚,1986 年 Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams 的反向传播可能根本没人看。
今天的深度学习圈大多忘了这条线，但 Hopfield 在 2024 年和 Hinton 一起拿了诺贝尔物理学奖，理由正是这次重新连接物理学与神经网络的突破。
events.card_summary_zh: Hopfield 用能量函数解释神经网络如何收敛到稳定记忆，连接主义由此重新获得数学上的可信度。
events.card_summary_en: John Hopfield used an energy function to explain how neural networks converge to stable memories, restoring mathematical credibility to connectionism.
events.summary_en: In April 1982, Caltech physicist John Hopfield published a landmark paper in PNAS introducing a symmetrically connected network of binary neurons. He introduced the concept of an "energy function," proving that the network's state descends along an energy gradient to converge at an attractor, or local minimum. Storing a memory in the network was akin to carving an attractor into an energy landscape; providing an incomplete input was like letting a ball roll into the nearest basin. This breakthrough gave neural networks a rigorous physical intuition, elevating them beyond mere psychological models.
events.context_en: The timing of Hopfield's publication was critical. In 1982, the field was nearing the end of the first AI winter, and neural networks had been largely forgotten by the mainstream artificial intelligence community. As a physicist rather than a traditional AI researcher, Hopfield published his work in PNAS instead of a dedicated AI journal. This strategic bypass allowed his research to avoid the prevailing biases of symbolic AI reviewers. His subsequent papers—introducing continuous Hopfield networks in 1984 and optimization computation with David W. Tank in 1985—successfully brought neural networks back into mainstream scientific discourse. These foundational contributions directly paved the way for the Parallel Distributed Processing (PDP) movement and the popularization of backpropagation in 1986.
events.why_it_matters_en: While the Hopfield network itself did not become a primary engineering workhorse, it fundamentally restored the premise that neural networks could perform rigorous computation. Without Hopfield's intervention, the 1986 backpropagation breakthrough by Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams might have struggled to gain traction. Although this historical trajectory is sometimes overlooked in modern deep learning, Hopfield's foundational work was ultimately recognized when he shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics with Geoffrey Hinton, specifically honoring this breakthrough that reconnected physics with artificial neural networks.

events.title_zh: Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams 反向传播:深度学习的工程起点
events.title_en: Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams Backpropagation Paper
events.summary_zh:
1986 年 10 月 9 日，Nature 323:533-536 发表《Learning representations by back-propagating errors》（Rumelhart, Hinton, Williams）。
论文把反向模式自动微分明确应用在多层神经网络上，给出干净的可计算梯度公式，让隐藏层权重可以用 SGD 更新。
虽然 Linnainmaa 1970 给过算法、Werbos 1974 在 PhD 里用过，但这篇 Nature 论文让 BP 成为 AI 圈共同语言，是深度学习工程化的真正起点。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Rumelhart 在 1986 年之前一直在 PDP 框架下研究认知模型，BP 最初是想解决“多层网络怎么学内部表征”这个认知科学问题。
Hinton 当时已经在做 Boltzmann Machine,Williams 在做强化学习，三人合写这篇短文（4 页）是 PDP 项目的一个副产品。
论文能发 Nature 是关键：它绕开了 AI 期刊的符号主义审稿偏见，把神经网络重新拉回主流科学视野。
Hinton 后来在 2024 年和 Hopfield 一起拿诺贝尔物理学奖，核心引用就是这条线。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
这篇 4 页论文是深度学习工程化的零时刻。
今天 GPT、Stable Diffusion、AlphaFold 的训练链路，底层都是 1986 年这次“把反向模式 AD 装进神经网络”的延伸。
理解 1970 Linnainmaa 算法 → 1974 Werbos 神经网络应用 → 1986 RHW Nature 论文这条三段线，才能看清为什么 BP 的“发明”和“普及”是两件事。
events.source_name: Rumelhart, D. E., Hinton, G. E., Williams, R. J. (1986). Nature 323:533-536
events.card_summary_zh: 反向传播让多层神经网络能够系统地修正误差，沉寂已久的连接主义终于获得可训练的工程方法。
events.card_summary_en: Backpropagation allowed multi-layer neural networks to systematically correct errors, finally providing the long-dormant connectionist movement with a trainable engineering method.
events.summary_en: On October 9, 1986, Nature published "Learning representations by back-propagating errors" by David Rumelhart, Geoffrey Hinton, and Ronald Williams. The paper explicitly applied reverse-mode automatic differentiation to multi-layer neural networks, providing a clean, computable gradient formula that allowed hidden layer weights to be updated using stochastic gradient descent. Although Seppo Linnainmaa introduced the underlying algorithm in 1970 and Paul Werbos applied it to neural networks in his 1974 PhD thesis, this Nature paper established backpropagation as a common language within the AI community, marking the true engineering starting point of deep learning.
events.context_en: Before 1986, David Rumelhart had been researching cognitive models under the Parallel Distributed Processing (PDP) framework. Backpropagation was initially intended to solve a fundamental cognitive science problem: how multi-layer networks could learn internal representations. At the time, Geoffrey Hinton was already working on Boltzmann machines, while Ronald Williams was focused on reinforcement learning. Their four-page collaborative paper was essentially a byproduct of the broader PDP project. Publishing in Nature proved to be a crucial strategic move. By doing so, the authors bypassed the symbolic AI bias prevalent among reviewers at traditional artificial intelligence journals, successfully bringing neural networks back into mainstream scientific visibility after years of skepticism. This foundational trajectory ultimately formed the core citation for Hinton's 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics, which he shared with John Hopfield for their foundational discoveries in machine learning.
events.why_it_matters_en: This four-page paper represents the engineering ground zero of deep learning. Today, the training pipelines for models like GPT, Stable Diffusion, and AlphaFold are all fundamental extensions of this 1986 breakthrough, which successfully integrated reverse-mode automatic differentiation into neural networks. Understanding the three-stage trajectory—from Linnainmaa's 1970 algorithm to Werbos's 1974 neural network application, and finally to the 1986 Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams Nature paper—clarifies why the initial invention of backpropagation and its widespread popularization were two distinct historical milestones.
events.source_author: D. E. Rumelhart, G. E. Hinton, R. J. Williams

events.title_zh: 第二次 AI 寒冬:LISP 机崩盘与专家系统时代结束
events.title_en: Second AI Winter: LISP Machine Collapse and End of Expert System Era
events.summary_zh:
1987-1993 年是 AI 史上最长的寒冬，起点是 1987 年下半年 LISP 机市场崩盘。
Symbolics、LMI 两家 LISP 机厂商销售额断崖式下跌，到 1988 年 Symbolics 破产保护，LMI 关闭；通用工作站（Sun、DEC、SGI）在性能价格比上全面碾压专用 LISP 硬件，AI 公司的硬件护城河一夜消失。
顶点是 1991 年 DARPA SCI 计划大幅削减 AI 通用资助，日本 FGCS 1992 年结算失败，结束点是 1993 年专家系统产业产值跌回 1980 年水平。
这六年间，CMU、MIT、斯坦福、SRI 的 AI 实验室经费腰斩，毕业生就业困难，大批研究者转向其他领域。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
第二次寒冬是“硬件+商业+政策”三重打击同步。
硬件层：通用工作站性能价格比全面碾压 LISP 机，专用硬件成包袱。
商业层:XCON 类专家系统在 1984-1986 年大量复制到医疗、法律、金融领域，维护成本爆炸、规则库过时、错误难定位，企业 ROI 算不下来，纷纷撤资。
政策层：美国 DARPA 1991 年 SCI 计划清算，日本 FGCS 1992 年结算失败。
三股力量叠加，这次寒冬比 1974 年第一次更深更久——1974 是“承诺兑现不了”,1987 是“商业模型跑不通”。
但寒冬里也埋了种子:LeCun 1989 CNN、Schölkopf 1995 SVM、Hochreiter 1997 LSTM 都是在寒冬里写出来的。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
第二次寒冬让 AI 圈把重心从“专家系统+符号推理”转向“统计学习+神经网络”,并塑造了 1990-2010 年 AI 圈的低调文化：“不画大饼，先证明小场景可用，再谈通用”。
这种文化让 2006 年 Hinton DBN、2012 年 AlexNet 能扎实积累，不至于被捧杀。
今天生成式 AI 圈的高调叙事和 1984 年专家系统泡沫几乎一模一样，理解第二次寒冬，才能识别今天的风险信号。
events.source_name: Crevier, G. (1993). AI: The Tumultuous History; Russell & Norvig AIAMA 4th ed Ch 1.4
events.card_summary_zh: LISP 机器市场崩盘、专家系统维护成本失控，AI 再次从资本宠儿跌入长期降温期。
events.card_summary_en: The collapse of the LISP machine market and the spiraling maintenance costs of expert systems triggered a prolonged period of reduced funding and interest in artificial intelligence.
events.summary_en: The longest "AI Winter" spanned from 1987 to 1993, triggered by the collapse of the LISP machine market. Dedicated hardware vendors like Symbolics and LMI saw sales plummet as general-purpose workstations from Sun, DEC, and SGI offered vastly superior price-to-performance ratios, instantly eroding AI companies' hardware moats. The downturn deepened when DARPA slashed general AI funding in 1991 and Japan's Fifth Generation Computer Systems (FGCS) project concluded unsuccessfully in 1992. By 1993, the expert system industry's value had regressed to 1980 levels. Major AI labs at CMU, MIT, Stanford, and SRI saw their budgets halved, forcing many researchers to abandon the field.
events.context_en: The Second AI Winter was driven by a simultaneous triple blow across hardware, business, and policy. On the hardware front, general-purpose workstations completely outpaced LISP machines in cost-effectiveness, turning specialized AI hardware into a liability. Commercially, expert systems like XCON had been widely replicated across medical, legal, and financial sectors between 1984 and 1986. However, these systems suffered from exploding maintenance costs, rapidly outdated rule bases, and difficult-to-isolate errors. Unable to justify the return on investment, enterprises withdrew their funding. On the policy side, major national initiatives collapsed, notably DARPA's Strategic Computing Initiative in the US and Japan's FGCS project. Combined, these forces created a deeper and longer freeze than the first AI Winter in 1974. While the 1974 downturn stemmed from unfulfilled promises, the 1987 crisis was rooted in fundamentally unviable business models. Yet, this harsh environment incubated foundational breakthroughs: Yann LeCun's convolutional neural networks (1989), Bernhard Schölkopf's work on support vector machines (1995), and Sepp Hochreiter and Jürgen Schmidhuber's LSTM (1997) were all developed during this prolonged winter.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Second AI Winter forced the research community to shift its primary focus from expert systems and symbolic reasoning toward statistical learning and neural networks. It also fostered a culture of pragmatism that dominated the field from 1990 to 2010, prioritizing proven utility in narrow applications over grandiose claims of general intelligence. This cautious environment allowed foundational breakthroughs like Geoffrey Hinton's deep belief networks in 2006 and AlexNet in 2012 to develop steadily without falling victim to hype cycles. Understanding the dynamics of the 1987 collapse provides critical historical context for evaluating the high-profile narratives surrounding modern generative AI, which bear striking similarities to the expert system bubble of the mid-1980s.

events.title_zh: Pearl 贝叶斯网络:让概率推理进入 AI
events.title_en: Pearl Bayesian Networks: Probabilistic Reasoning Enters AI
events.summary_zh:
1985-1988 年，UCLA 的 Judea Pearl 系统化提出贝叶斯网络（Bayesian Network),1988 年 9 月由 Morgan Kaufmann 出版《Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems: Networks of Plausible Inference》。
贝叶斯网络用有向无环图（DAG）表达变量间的条件依赖，节点 = 随机变量，边 = 条件概率关系。
推理 = 在 DAG 上做信念传播（Belief Propagation）。
这把概率推理从模糊的“不确定性”变成可计算、可可视化的结构。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Pearl 1985 年在 UAI 会议上首次提出贝叶斯网络框架,1986-1988 年密集发表一系列论文把理论完善。
他的核心洞察是：专家系统里的不确定性不是“加一个置信度就行”,而是要把“因果结构”和“概率推理”分开建模。
Pearl 后来在 1995-2000 年代把贝叶斯网络扩展到因果推断（Causal Inference),提出 do-calculus,2011 年拿图灵奖。
今天 LLM 圈讨论的“相关性 vs 因果性”大多回到 Pearl 这套语言。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
贝叶斯网络是 1990-2010 年概率 AI 的主力工具，广泛应用于医疗诊断、故障定位、自然语言理解、推荐系统。
今天 LLM 虽然取代了大量概率 AI 应用，但在医疗、法律、保险等高责任场景，贝叶斯网络仍然是可解释推理的首选。
Pearl 的因果推断框架，也是当前 AI 圈讨论“LLM 能不能做因果推理”的理论坐标系。
events.source_name: Pearl, J. (1988). Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems. Morgan Kaufmann; Turing Award 2011
events.card_summary_zh: 贝叶斯网络让机器能够在信息不完整时更新判断，概率推理从此进入 AI 的核心工具箱。
events.card_summary_en: Bayesian networks enabled machines to update judgments with incomplete information, cementing probabilistic reasoning as a core tool in the artificial intelligence toolkit.
events.summary_en: Between 1985 and 1988, UCLA researcher Judea Pearl systematically developed Bayesian networks, culminating in the September 1988 publication of his book, Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems: Networks of Plausible Inference, by Morgan Kaufmann. Bayesian networks use directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to represent conditional dependencies between variables, where nodes represent random variables and edges denote conditional probability relationships. In this framework, reasoning is performed through belief propagation across the DAG. This approach transformed probabilistic reasoning from a vague concept of uncertainty into a strictly computable and visualizable structure.
events.context_en: Pearl first proposed the Bayesian network framework at the 1985 Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI), refining the theory through a dense series of papers published between 1986 and 1988. His core insight was that handling uncertainty in expert systems required more than simply attaching confidence scores to rules; it necessitated modeling causal structures separately from probabilistic reasoning. Pearl later expanded Bayesian networks into the broader field of causal inference during the late 1990s and 2000s, introducing the do-calculus—foundational work that ultimately earned him the Turing Award in 2011. Today, much of the debate within the AI community regarding whether large language models capture mere correlation or true causation still relies heavily on Pearl's theoretical language and frameworks.
events.why_it_matters_en: Bayesian networks served as the primary tool for probabilistic AI from 1990 to 2010, finding widespread application in medical diagnosis, fault localization, natural language understanding, and recommendation systems. Although large language models have since replaced many traditional probabilistic AI applications, Bayesian networks remain a preferred choice for interpretable reasoning in high-stakes, high-responsibility domains like healthcare, law, and insurance. Furthermore, Pearl's causal inference framework continues to serve as the theoretical coordinate system for ongoing industry discussions about whether foundation models can perform genuine causal reasoning.

events.title_zh: Watkins Q-learning:强化学习的核心算法
events.title_en: Watkins Q-learning: Core Algorithm of Reinforcement Learning
events.summary_zh:
1989 年，Christopher Watkins 在剑桥大学提交博士论文《Learning from Delayed Rewards》。
提出 Q-learning 算法：智能体在状态 s 下采取动作 a,观察到奖励 r 和下一状态 s',更新 Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a) + α[r + γ max Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)]。
这是 off-policy 时序差分学习的关键形式，在足够探索和衰减学习率下可证明收敛到最优 Q 函数。
Q-learning 与 Sutton 1984/1988 的 TD(λ）同属时序差分家族，但二者有别:Q-learning 是 off-policy 的动作价值迭代，TD(λ）是状态价值预测。1992 年 Tesauro 的 TD-Gammon 用的是 TD(λ)（而非 Q-learning）在西洋双陆棋上达到接近顶尖选手水平，让主流重新关注强化学习。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Watkins 1989 论文写在第二次 AI 寒冬最深处，强化学习当时是冷门方向，主要继承 Bellman 1957 动态规划、Sutton 1984 TD(λ）、Barto 1983 Actor-Critic 等少量先驱工作。
Q-learning 的关键贡献是把“探索”和“利用”明确分离，off-policy 让智能体可以用任意行为策略收集数据，而 Q 函数依然收敛到最优。
2013-2015 年 DeepMind 的 DQN 在 Atari 上突破，本质是 Q-learning + 神经网络。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
Q-learning 是强化学习工程化的零时刻。
今天 AlphaGo、AlphaStar、ChatGPT RLHF 阶段的核心算法 PPO,都建立在 Q-learning 时序差分框架之上。
理解 1989 年 Watkins 这条线，才能看清 2015 年 DQN、2017 年 PPO 不是凭空冒出来，而是 30 年 RL 工程积累的爆发。
events.source_name: Watkins, C. J. C. H. (1989). PhD thesis, University of Cambridge; (1992) Machine Learning 8(3-4)
events.card_summary_zh: Q-learning 让智能体不必知道环境模型，也能通过试错逼近最优策略，成为强化学习最经典的起点之一。
events.card_summary_en: Q-learning enabled AI agents to approximate optimal policies through trial and error without needing a model of the environment, establishing one of the most classic foundations of reinforcement learning.
events.summary_en: In 1989, Christopher Watkins submitted his Cambridge PhD thesis, Learning from Delayed Rewards, introducing the Q-learning algorithm. This method allows an agent to update its action-value function based on observed rewards and subsequent states. As a key form of off-policy temporal difference (TD) learning, it is proven to converge to the optimal Q-function given sufficient exploration and a decaying learning rate. While Q-learning and Richard Sutton's TD(λ) both belong to the TD family, Q-learning focuses on off-policy action-value iteration, whereas TD(λ) predicts state values. (Gerald Tesauro's 1992 TD-Gammon, which revived mainstream interest in reinforcement learning, utilized TD(λ) rather than Q-learning).
events.context_en: Watkins wrote his 1989 thesis during the depths of the second AI winter, a period when reinforcement learning was a niche research area. The field primarily built upon a small number of pioneering works, including Richard Bellman's 1957 dynamic programming, Sutton's 1984 TD(λ), and Andrew Barto's 1983 Actor-Critic methods. The critical contribution of Q-learning was the explicit separation of exploration and exploitation. Its off-policy nature meant that an agent could use any behavioral policy to collect data, while the Q-function would still reliably converge to the optimal policy. This foundational breakthrough laid the groundwork for future milestones. Decades later, DeepMind's Deep Q-Network (DQN), which achieved breakthrough performance on Atari games between 2013 and 2015, was fundamentally built by combining Q-learning with deep neural networks.
events.why_it_matters_en: Q-learning represents the starting point for the engineering of reinforcement learning. Today, the core algorithms behind systems like AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) used in ChatGPT's RLHF phase are all built upon the temporal difference framework established by Q-learning. Understanding Watkins' 1989 contribution is essential for recognizing that later breakthroughs—such as DQN in 2015 and PPO in 2017—did not emerge in a vacuum. Rather, they were the culmination of nearly 30 years of accumulated reinforcement learning research and engineering.

events.title_zh: LeCun 卷积网络:神经网走进银行与邮局
events.title_en: LeCun Convolutional Network for Handwriting Recognition
events.summary_zh:
1989 年冬，Yann LeCun 等人在 Neural Computation 1(4):541-551 发表《Backpropagation Applied to Handwritten Zip Code Recognition》。
这是第一个真正可用的工业级卷积神经网络，用于 USPS 邮政编码识别，输入 16×16 像素,3 个卷积隐藏层，约 1000 个神经元。
1993 年 LeCun 团队进一步在 AT&T 部署商业版本 LeNet,用于 NCR 的支票自动读取，美国 90% 的支票金额识别都跑在 LeNet 上。
这是神经网络第一次大规模进入生产环境。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
LeCun 1988 年从 Hinton 实验室博士毕业到 AT&T Bell Labs,当时 Bell Labs 有一笔 USPS 手写邮编识别的合同要交付。
传统方法是手工设计特征 + 分类器，识别率 80% 左右。
LeCun 提出直接喂原始像素给卷积网络，用 1986 年 RHW 的反向传播训练，第一版就做到 95% 以上，远超传统方法。
LeNet 的卷积+池化+全连接结构，成为后来 AlexNet、ResNet 的母版。
LeCun 2018 年拿图灵奖，核心引用就是这条线。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
LeCun 1989 这篇论文是 CNN 工程化的零时刻。
它证明反向传播训练的神经网络可以在真实业务里跑通，在第二次 AI 寒冬最冷的时刻给连接主义续了一口气。
后来 AlexNet 2012 年本质上是把 LeNet 放大 + GPU 训练，技术路线在 1989 年已经成型，只是等算力追上。
events.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1989). Neural Computation 1(4):541-551; (1998) Proc. IEEE 86(11)
events.card_summary_zh: LeCun 的卷积网络开始真实识别银行支票和邮政编码，神经网络第一次从论文走进日常工业系统。
events.card_summary_en: Yann LeCun's convolutional neural network successfully recognized handwritten bank checks and zip codes, marking the first time neural networks transitioned from academic papers into daily industrial systems.
events.summary_en: In the winter of 1989, Yann LeCun and colleagues published "Backpropagation Applied to Handwritten Zip Code Recognition" in Neural Computation. This introduced the first truly viable industrial-grade convolutional neural network (CNN), designed to recognize US Postal Service zip codes. The model processed 16×16 pixel inputs through three convolutional hidden layers containing approximately 1,000 neurons. By 1993, LeCun's team at AT&T deployed a commercial version, LeNet, for automated check reading by NCR. Eventually, LeNet processed 90% of all bank checks in the United States, representing the first large-scale deployment of neural networks in a production environment.
events.context_en: After working in Geoffrey Hinton's lab in 1988, Yann LeCun joined AT&T Bell Labs. At the time, Bell Labs was working to fulfill a contract with the US Postal Service for handwritten zip code recognition. Traditional methods relied on hand-crafted features combined with classifiers, achieving an accuracy rate of around 80%. LeCun proposed feeding raw pixels directly into a convolutional network trained using the backpropagation algorithm popularized in 1986. His first iteration achieved over 95% accuracy, significantly outperforming traditional approaches. The resulting LeNet architecture—combining convolutional layers, pooling layers, and fully connected layers—served as the foundational template for later breakthrough models like AlexNet and ResNet. This trajectory of research into convolutional networks was a central citation when LeCun was awarded the Turing Award in 2018.
events.why_it_matters_en: LeCun's 1989 paper marks the genesis of engineering convolutional neural networks for real-world applications. It proved that neural networks trained via backpropagation could successfully operate in commercial environments, providing a crucial lifeline for connectionist AI during the depths of the second AI winter. The model trajectory established in 1989 was fundamentally sound; when AlexNet emerged in 2012, it essentially scaled up the LeNet architecture and trained it on GPUs. The foundational technical path had already been formed decades earlier, simply waiting for compute power to catch up.

events.title_zh: Cortes-Vapnik SVM:统计学习的核心算法
events.title_en: Cortes-Vapnik Support Vector Machine
events.summary_zh:
1995 年 9 月，Corinna Cortes 和 Vladimir Vapnik 在 Machine Learning 20(3):273-297 发表《Support-Vector Networks》。
SVM 在特征空间中找一个最大间隔超平面分割两类，由距离边界最近的少数“支持向量”决定分类器。
通过核函数（kernel trick）把数据映射到高维空间，SVM 可以处理线性不可分问题。
常用核：线性、多项式、RBF(Gaussian）。
SVM 在 1996-2010 年是机器学习的主力算法，广泛应用于文本分类、生物信息、图像识别、金融风控。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
SVM 是 Vapnik 在 AT&T Bell Labs 工作时发展出来的，和 LeCun 同一个实验室，两人长期学术争论。
Vapnik 的统计学习理论（1979 俄文版,1995 英文版 The Nature of Statistical Learning Theory）证明在有限样本下，SVM 的泛化误差有上界，这给 90 年代末“小数据 + 强理论”派提供了武器。
2000 年代 SVM vs 神经网络之争在 NIPS 上反复出现，直到 2012 年 AlexNet 在 ImageNet 上证明深度网络胜出，SVM 才退居二线，作为基线模型和理论教学工具保留下来。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
SVM 是 90 年代-2000 年代机器学习的主力，把统计学习理论推到工程高峰。
今天 LLM 圈虽然不用 SVM 训大模型，但 SVM 的“最大间隔”思想和“核技巧”依然在分类、聚类、异常检测任务里广泛使用。
理解 SVM,才能理解为什么 2000 年代 Hinton 团队坚持深度学习被主流怀疑了 10 年才被接受。
events.source_name: Cortes, C. & Vapnik, V. (1995). Machine Learning 20(3):273-297; Vapnik (1995) The Nature of Statistical Learning Theory
events.card_summary_zh: 支持向量机用最大间隔寻找分类边界，在深度学习之前长期统治高维、小样本的机器学习任务。
events.card_summary_en: Support Vector Machines (SVMs) find classification boundaries using maximum margins, dominating high-dimensional, small-sample machine learning tasks long before the deep learning era.
events.summary_en: In September 1995, Corinna Cortes and Vladimir Vapnik published "Support-Vector Networks" in the journal Machine Learning. The Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm separates classes by finding a maximum-margin hyperplane in a feature space, with the classifier determined by a small number of "support vectors" closest to the boundary. By utilizing the "kernel trick" to map data into high-dimensional spaces, SVMs can effectively handle linearly inseparable problems using linear, polynomial, or Gaussian (RBF) kernels. From 1996 to 2010, SVM served as the primary algorithm in machine learning, seeing widespread application across text classification, bioinformatics, image recognition, and financial risk control.
events.context_en: Vladimir Vapnik developed the SVM algorithm while working at AT&T Bell Labs, sharing a laboratory with Yann LeCun, which led to a long-standing academic debate between the two researchers. Vapnik’s statistical learning theory—first published in Russian in 1979 and translated to English in 1995 as The Nature of Statistical Learning Theory—proved that SVMs have an upper bound on generalization error even with limited samples. This mathematical rigor provided a powerful weapon for the "small data plus strong theory" camp of the late 1990s. Throughout the 2000s, the debate between SVMs and neural networks repeatedly surfaced at major conferences like NIPS (now NeurIPS). It was not until 2012, when AlexNet decisively demonstrated the superiority of deep neural networks on the ImageNet dataset, that SVMs finally retreated to the background. Today, they are primarily retained as baseline models and essential pedagogical tools in theoretical machine learning.
events.why_it_matters_en: SVM was the dominant force in machine learning throughout the 1990s and 2000s, pushing statistical learning theory to its engineering peak. Although modern large language models do not rely on SVMs for training, the algorithm's core concepts of "maximum margin" and the "kernel trick" remain widely used in classification, clustering, and anomaly detection tasks. More importantly, understanding the historical dominance of SVMs is crucial for comprehending the broader trajectory of AI research. It explains why Geoffrey Hinton's team and other deep learning pioneers faced a decade of skepticism from the mainstream academic community before neural networks were finally embraced in the 2010s.

events.title_zh: IBM 深蓝击败卡斯帕罗夫:AI 的第一次大众胜利
events.title_en: IBM Deep Blue Defeats Kasparov
events.summary_zh:
1997 年 5 月 11 日，IBM 深蓝（Deep Blue）在纽约衡平中心（Equitable Center)6 局对抗赛中，以 3.5:2.5(2 胜 1 负 3 和）击败国际象棋世界冠军 Garry Kasparov。
深蓝由 Feng-hsiung Hsu、Joe Hoane、Murray Campbell 团队设计，运行在 IBM RS/6000 SP 超级计算机上（30 个节点,480 个专用 VLSI 象棋芯片),每秒搜索 2 亿个局面。
深蓝是“暴力搜索 + 人工评估函数”的极致，不学习，不适应，只靠算力碾压。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
深蓝项目从 1985 年 Hsu 在 CMU 读博士时启动（ChipTest → Deep Thought → Deep Blue),1989 年 IBM 收购 Hsu 团队,1996 年 2 月深蓝 1.0 首次对弈 Kasparov,Kasparov 以 4–2 击败深蓝（深蓝输）。
1997 年 5 月深蓝 2.0 在第 6 局的关键第 36 手 Kasparov 投降，Kasparov 后期抱怨深蓝“像有神助”,怀疑 IBM 作弊，IBM 拒绝公布深蓝搜索细节，后续拆掉机器结束项目。
Kasparov 2017 年在《Deep Thinking》一书里收回部分指控，承认自己在 1997 年状态不佳，但仍然质疑 IBM 处理方式。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
深蓝是 AI 第一次在大众媒体上“击败人类冠军”的事件。
它给 AI 圈带来 1997-2001 年的小阳春，也让公众第一次相信“计算机能在智力任务上超过人”。
但深蓝路线（暴力搜索）和今天 LLM 路线（深度学习）是两条完全不同的路。
理解深蓝，可看出为什么 AlphaGo 2016 年突破在本质上是另一种胜利，而不是深蓝的延伸。
events.source_name: Hsu, F.-h. (2002). Behind Deep Blue; Campbell, M. et al. (2002) AI Journal 134(1-2):57-83
events.card_summary_zh: 深蓝在正式比赛中击败世界棋王，AI 第一次以全球公众都能理解的方式展示机器计算的压倒性力量。
events.card_summary_en: By defeating the reigning world chess champion in an official match, IBM's Deep Blue provided the global public with their first clear demonstration of overwhelming machine computation.
events.summary_en: IBM's Deep Blue defeated reigning world chess champion Garry Kasparov with a score of 3.5 to 2.5 (two wins, one loss, three draws) in a six-game match at New York's Equitable Center. Designed by a team including Feng-hsiung Hsu, Joe Hoane, and Murray Campbell, the system ran on an IBM RS/6000 SP supercomputer equipped with 30 nodes and 480 custom VLSI chess chips, enabling it to evaluate 200 million positions per second. Deep Blue represented the absolute pinnacle of brute-force search combined with handcrafted evaluation functions. It did not learn or adapt; instead, it achieved victory purely through overwhelming computational power.
events.context_en: The project originated in 1985 during Feng-hsiung Hsu’s doctoral studies at Carnegie Mellon University, evolving from ChipTest to Deep Thought before becoming Deep Blue. IBM hired Hsu’s team in 1989 to continue their work. In their first encounter in February 1996, Kasparov defeated an earlier version of Deep Blue 4–2. During the decisive sixth game of the 1997 rematch, Kasparov resigned on the 36th move. Following the defeat, Kasparov accused the machine of displaying human-like intuition and suspected IBM of human intervention. IBM denied the allegations but refused to release the detailed search logs, eventually dismantling the machine and ending the project. In his 2017 book *Deep Thinking*, Kasparov retracted some of his initial cheating accusations, acknowledging that he was in poor form during the 1997 match, though he maintained his criticism of IBM's lack of transparency and handling of the event.
events.why_it_matters_en: Deep Blue marked the first widely publicized instance of an artificial intelligence defeating a reigning human world champion. The victory triggered a brief resurgence of enthusiasm in the AI field from 1997 to 2001, convincing the general public that computers could genuinely surpass human capabilities in complex intellectual tasks. However, Deep Blue’s reliance on brute-force search represents a fundamentally different technological trajectory from modern deep learning and large language models. Understanding this distinction highlights why AlphaGo’s 2016 triumph was not merely an extension of Deep Blue’s legacy, but a completely different paradigm of AI achievement.

events.title_zh: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM:序列建模的支柱
events.title_en: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM
events.summary_zh:
1997 年 11 月 15 日，Sepp Hochreiter 和 Jürgen Schmidhuber 在Neural Computation 9(8):1735-1780 发表《Long Short-Term Memory》。
LSTM 引入“细胞状态 + 输入门 + 输出门 + 恒定误差传送带（CEC)”的结构，解决 RNN 在反向传播中梯度消失问题，让网络能学习跨数百个时间步的长期依赖（1997 年原版只有输入门和输出门；遗忘门由 Gers、Schmidhuber、Cummins 在 2000 年《Learning to Forget》中补充，才形成今天的三门结构）。
LSTM 在 2009-2017 年是序列建模的主力，Google 翻译、Apple Siri、Amazon Alexa 第一代都跑在 LSTM 上，直到 2017 年 Transformer 出现才被替代。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
LSTM 的源头是 Hochreiter 1991 年硕士论文，他在论文里第一次系统描述了 RNN 的梯度消失问题，并指出这是深层网络训练的根本障碍。
Hochreiter 把硕士论文带到 Schmidhuber 那里，两人花了 6 年把 LSTM 完整化,1997 年才发表在 Neural Computation。
LSTM 早期反响平平，直到 2009 年 Sutskever、Hinton 团队证明 LSTM 在语音识别、机器翻译上远超传统 HMM,才进入工业主流。
Hochreiter 2024 年和 Hinton 一起被频繁提名诺贝尔奖候选，LSTM 的影响在 Transformer 时代反而被重新评估。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
LSTM 是 Transformer 之前序列建模的支柱。
今天 LLM 圈讨论的“长期记忆”“注意力”“上下文窗口”,在 2017 年前都是 LSTM 在解决。
理解 LSTM 的“门控记忆”设计，可看出 Transformer 的注意力机制为什么能让 LLM 跨越语言理解鸿沟。
events.source_name: Hochreiter, S. & Schmidhuber, J. (1997). Neural Computation 9(8):1735-1780
events.card_summary_zh: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM：序列建模的支柱；LSTM 是 Transformer 之前序列建模的支柱。
events.card_summary_en: Sepp Hochreiter and Jürgen Schmidhuber published the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture, which solved the vanishing gradient problem in RNNs and served as the foundational pillar of sequence modeling before the Transformer era.
events.summary_en: Sepp Hochreiter and Jürgen Schmidhuber published "Long Short-Term Memory" in Neural Computation. The LSTM architecture introduced a cell state, input and output gates, and a constant error carousel (CEC) to solve the vanishing gradient problem in recurrent neural networks (RNNs). This enabled networks to learn long-term dependencies across hundreds of time steps. (The modern three-gate structure was finalized in 2000 when Felix Gers, Schmidhuber, and Fred Cummins added the "forget gate.") From 2009 to 2017, LSTM dominated sequence modeling, powering early versions of Google Translate, Apple's Siri, and Amazon Alexa before being largely superseded by the Transformer architecture.
events.context_en: The origins of LSTM trace back to Hochreiter's 1991 master's thesis, which provided the first systematic description of the vanishing gradient problem in RNNs, identifying it as a fundamental obstacle to training deep networks. Hochreiter brought this work to Schmidhuber, and the two spent six years refining the LSTM architecture before publishing it in 1997. Initially, the paper received a lukewarm response. It was not until around 2009, when researchers including Ilya Sutskever and Geoffrey Hinton demonstrated that LSTMs significantly outperformed traditional Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) in speech recognition and machine translation, that the architecture entered the industrial mainstream. Decades later, Hochreiter was frequently mentioned alongside Hinton as a candidate for the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics, reflecting a renewed appreciation for LSTM's foundational impact even in the Transformer era.
events.why_it_matters_en: LSTM served as the undisputed pillar of sequence modeling prior to the Transformer. The core challenges discussed in today's large language model (LLM) landscape—such as long-term memory, attention, and context windows—were primarily addressed by LSTMs before 2017. Understanding LSTM's gated memory design provides crucial historical context for why the subsequent shift to the Transformer's attention mechanism was necessary to help LLMs bridge the gap in complex language understanding.

events.title_zh: LeNet-5 论文:卷积网络的工程化文档
events.title_en: LeNet-5 Paper: Engineering Documentation of CNNs
events.summary_zh:
1998 年 11 月，Yann LeCun、Léon Bottou、Yoshua Bengio、Patrick Haffner 在Proceedings of the IEEE 86(11):2278-2324 发表《Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition》。
论文系统化描述 LeNet-5 结构（7 层:Conv-Pool-Conv-Pool-FC-FC-Output),用反向传播端到端训练，直接吃原始像素，用于 MNIST 手写数字识别（错误率 0.95%）和银行支票金额识别。
LeNet-5 论文是 CNN 的工程化教科书，定义了 Conv→Pool→FC 的标准范式,2012 年 AlexNet 本质上是 LeNet-5 放大版 + GPU 训练 + ReLU 激活。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
LeNet-5 论文发表时正值第二次 AI 寒冬最深处，LeCun 在 AT&T 已部署 LeNet 到 NCR 支票读取系统，美国 90% 支票金额识别跑在 LeNet 上，但 AI 主流圈把“神经网络”当成 80 年代失败路线的回光返照。
LeCun 论文里写道:“我们相信神经网络已经成熟，可以成为模式识别的标准工具”,这个判断在 1998 年被主流忽视,2012 年才被证明正确。
LeNet-5 论文里还包含 LeCun 早期的“不归一化输入 → 性能下降”等工程经验，这些经验在 2012 年 AlexNet 里被重新发现。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
LeNet-5 是深度学习工程化的母版论文。
今天所有 CNN 都建立在 LeNet-5 的“局部感受野 + 权值共享 + 池化 + 全连接”范式上。
理解 LeNet-5,可看出 AlexNet 2012 年的突破不是凭空冒出来，而是 14 年工程积累 + GPU 算力 + ImageNet 数据规模三个条件成熟后的爆发。
events.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1998). Proc. IEEE 86(11):2278-2324; MNIST dataset
events.card_summary_zh: LeNet-5 固化了卷积、池化与全连接的组合方式，后来视觉神经网络的工程骨架由此成形。
events.card_summary_en: LeNet-5 solidified the combination of convolutional, pooling, and fully connected layers, establishing the engineering framework that would define modern visual neural networks.
events.summary_en: In November 1998, Yann LeCun, Léon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio, and Patrick Haffner published "Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition" in the Proceedings of the IEEE. The paper systematically described the seven-layer LeNet-5 architecture (Conv-Pool-Conv-Pool-FC-FC-Output). Trained end-to-end using backpropagation directly on raw pixels, it achieved a 0.95% error rate on the MNIST handwritten digit dataset and was deployed for bank check recognition. Serving as an engineering textbook for convolutional neural networks (CNNs), the paper defined the standard Conv→Pool→FC paradigm. Ultimately, the 2012 AlexNet was essentially a scaled-up LeNet-5 augmented with GPU training and ReLU activation.
events.context_en: The LeNet-5 paper was published during the depths of the second AI winter. At AT&T, LeCun had already deployed LeNet into NCR check-reading systems, eventually processing roughly 90% of bank checks in the United States. Despite this commercial success, the mainstream AI community largely dismissed neural networks as a failed relic of the 1980s. In the paper, LeCun wrote, "We believe that neural networks are now mature enough to become standard tools for pattern recognition." This assessment was widely ignored in 1998, only to be vindicated in 2012. Furthermore, the LeNet-5 paper documented crucial early engineering heuristics—such as noting that failing to normalize inputs leads to performance degradation—which were later "rediscovered" during the development of AlexNet and other modern architectures.
events.why_it_matters_en: LeNet-5 serves as the foundational blueprint for deep learning engineering. Virtually all modern CNNs are built upon the paradigm it established: local receptive fields, weight sharing, spatial pooling, and fully connected layers. Understanding LeNet-5 reveals that the 2012 AlexNet breakthrough did not emerge in a vacuum. Instead, it was the culmination of 14 years of engineering accumulation, finally unlocked by the maturation of GPU compute and the scale of the ImageNet dataset.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA GeForce 256:GPU 时代开启
events.title_en: NVIDIA GeForce 256: GPU Era Begins
events.summary_zh:
1999 年 10 月 11 日，NVIDIA 发布 GeForce 256,售价 199 美元。
NVIDIA 把它宣传为“世界第一款 GPU(Graphics Processing Unit)”,首次把 Transform、Lighting、Setup、Rendering 四阶段整合到单芯片，支持硬件 T&L,集成 2300 万晶体管，核心 120MHz,显存 64MB DDR。
GeForce 256 同时是消费级显卡和并行计算硬件的开端，为 2006 年 CUDA、2012 年 AlexNet GPU 训练、2017 年 Transformer 大模型奠定算力基础。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
GPU 并行计算的潜能早期只有图形圈和少数 AI 学者意识到。
2004 年 Ian Buck 在斯坦福用 GPU 跑矩阵乘法,2007 年 NVIDIA 推出 CUDA,把 GPU 从“图形专用”变成“通用并行计算”。
2009 年 Rajat Raina、Andrew Ng 在斯坦福用 GPU 训练深度信念网络，训练时间从几周缩短到几天，这是 Hinton 团队 2012 年 AlexNet 决定用 GPU 的直接源头。
今天 NVIDIA H100、B100 几乎垄断 LLM 训练算力市场，GeForce 256 是这条线最早的起点。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
没有 GPU,就没有深度学习时代。
今天 LLM 训练算力 99% 跑在 NVIDIA GPU 上，GeForce 256 是这条硬件线的起点。
理解 1999-2009 年 GPU 从图形硬件到通用并行计算的转型，可看出为什么 2012 年 AlexNet 能引爆深度学习，而不是停留在 1998 年 LeNet 的水平。
events.source_name: NVIDIA GeForce 256 press release (1999-10-11); Buck, I. (2004) Stanford PhD
events.card_summary_zh: GeForce 256 把大规模并行图形计算带入消费市场，也为十多年后的深度学习算力革命埋下伏笔。
events.card_summary_en: The NVIDIA GeForce 256 brought large-scale parallel graphics computing to the consumer market, laying the foundational hardware architecture for the deep learning compute revolution that would follow over a decade later.
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released the GeForce 256, priced at $199, marketing it as the "world's first GPU (Graphics Processing Unit)." The chip integrated transform, lighting, setup, and rendering into a single processor, featuring hardware T&L (Transform and Lighting), 23 million transistors, a 120MHz core clock, and 64MB of DDR memory. Beyond serving as a consumer graphics card, the GeForce 256 marked the beginning of parallel computing hardware. This architecture established the foundational compute paradigm that would eventually support the 2006 release of CUDA, the GPU-trained AlexNet in 2012, and the rise of Transformer-based large language models.
events.context_en: Initially, the potential of GPU parallel computing was recognized only by graphics specialists and a small number of AI researchers. In 2004, Ian Buck at Stanford University demonstrated the use of GPUs for matrix multiplication. This momentum led NVIDIA to release CUDA in 2007, transitioning the GPU from a dedicated graphics processor to a general-purpose parallel computing platform. By 2009, Stanford researchers Rajat Raina and Andrew Ng used GPUs to train deep belief networks, reducing training time from weeks to days. This breakthrough directly influenced Geoffrey Hinton's team to utilize GPUs for training AlexNet in 2012. Today, NVIDIA's advanced accelerators, such as the H100 and B100, dominate the compute market for training large language models. The GeForce 256 represents the earliest starting point of this hardware trajectory.
events.why_it_matters_en: The deep learning era is fundamentally built upon the parallel processing capabilities of GPUs. With the vast majority of modern large language model training relying on NVIDIA hardware, the GeForce 256 stands as the critical origin point of this compute trajectory. Understanding the GPU's transition from dedicated graphics hardware to a general-purpose parallel computing platform between 1999 and 2009 explains why AlexNet was able to trigger the deep learning boom in 2012, overcoming the computational bottlenecks that had previously constrained earlier neural networks like the 1998 LeNet.

events.title_zh: Hinton-Salakhutdinov DBN:深度学习复兴起点
events.title_en: Hinton-Salakhutdinov DBN: Deep Learning Revival
events.summary_zh:
2006 年 7 月 28 日，Geoffrey Hinton 和 Ruslan Salakhutdinov 在Science 313(5786):504-507 发表《Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks》。
论文用 Restricted Boltzmann Machine 预训练 + 反向传播微调，在 MNIST 上把自编码器降维错误率从 PCA 的 14.8% 降到 6.4%。
这是 Deep Belief Network(DBN）的工程化论文，重新证明多层神经网络可以训练，也正式让“deep learning”一词进入主流。
同年 Hinton 在 NIPS 发表《A Fast Learning Algorithm for Deep Belief Nets》，进一步推广 DBN 训练方法。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Hinton 团队 2002-2006 年在多伦多开发 Contrastive Divergence(CD）训练算法，解决 RBM 训练慢的问题。
DBN 论文能发 Science 是关键：它绕开了 AI 期刊里“神经网络已死”的偏见，把深度学习重新带回主流科学视野。
Hinton 团队 2009 年和 Microsoft、Google 合作，把 DBN 用在语音识别上,2010-2011 年 DNN-HMM 把 TIMIT 错误率从 24.8% 降到 16.0%,直接催生 2012 年 AlexNet 在 ImageNet 上的突破。
Hinton 2024 年和 Hopfield 一起拿诺贝尔物理学奖，核心引用就是这条线。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
2006 Hinton DBN 是深度学习时代的零时刻。
今天 GPT、Stable Diffusion、AlphaFold 的技术树都建立在这次突破之上。
理解 2006 DBN → 2009 DBN 语音 → 2012 AlexNet → 2014 GAN → 2017 Transformer → 2020 GPT-3 这条线，才能看清深度学习不是 2012 年凭空爆发的，而是 Hinton 团队 8 年坚持 + 算力 + 数据三个条件成熟的结果。
events.source_name: Hinton, G. E. & Salakhutdinov, R. (2006) Science 313(5786):504-507; Hinton et al. (2006) NIPS
events.card_summary_zh: 深度置信网络证明多层神经网络仍然可以有效训练，“深度学习”由此重新回到主流研究视野。
events.card_summary_en: Deep belief networks demonstrated that multi-layer neural networks could be trained effectively, bringing deep learning back into mainstream research.
events.summary_en: Geoffrey Hinton and Ruslan Salakhutdinov published "Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks" in Science. The paper introduced a method using Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) pre-training followed by backpropagation fine-tuning. On the MNIST dataset, this approach reduced the autoencoder dimensionality reduction error rate to 6.4%, compared to 14.8% for Principal Component Analysis (PCA). As a foundational engineering paper for Deep Belief Networks (DBNs), it proved that multi-layer neural networks could be effectively trained, officially bringing the term "deep learning" into the mainstream. Later that year, Hinton published a related paper at NIPS to further promote DBN training methods.
events.context_en: Between 2002 and 2006, Hinton's team at the University of Toronto developed the Contrastive Divergence (CD) training algorithm to solve the slow training speeds of RBMs. Publishing the DBN paper in Science was a strategic breakthrough: it bypassed the prevailing bias in AI journals that "neural networks were dead," successfully reintroducing deep learning to the broader scientific community. In 2009, Hinton's team collaborated with Microsoft and Google to apply DBNs to speech recognition. By 2010–2011, the resulting DNN-HMM architecture reduced the error rate on the TIMIT dataset from 24.8% to 16.0%. This success in speech recognition directly paved the way for the landmark AlexNet breakthrough on ImageNet in 2012. Furthermore, when Hinton and John Hopfield were awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2024, this trajectory of foundational research was a core citation.
events.why_it_matters_en: The 2006 DBN paper represents ground zero for the modern deep learning era. The technological family trees of contemporary models like GPT, Stable Diffusion, and AlphaFold are all rooted in this foundational breakthrough. Tracing the trajectory from the 2006 DBN to 2009 speech recognition, the 2012 AlexNet milestone, 2014 GANs, the 2017 Transformer, and GPT-3 in 2020 reveals that deep learning did not emerge out of nowhere in 2012. Instead, it was the culmination of eight years of persistence by Hinton's team, converging with the maturation of computational power and large-scale datasets.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 正式发布:GPU 走入通用计算
events.title_en: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 Released: GPU Goes General Purpose
events.summary_zh:
2007 年 2 月 14 日，NVIDIA 发布 CUDA 1.0 正式版，支持 GeForce 8 系列、Quadro FX 4600/5600、Tesla C870/G80 等硬件。
CUDA 1.0 包含 nvcc 编译器、CUDA Runtime、cuBLAS、cuFFT、CUDA GDB,让 C 语言开发者可以直接在 GPU 上编程矩阵乘、卷积、FFT 等高并行计算。
2007 年也是 NVIDIA Tesla GPU 计算品牌启动的年份，面向 HPC 和 AI 工作负载的专用产品线开始独立。
2007-2010 年 CUDA SDK 逐步完善,2010 年 cuDNN 前身 cuBLAS-XT、2014 年 cuDNN 1.0,成为深度学习框架的底层依赖。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
CUDA 1.0 发布时 NVIDIA 营收主要靠游戏显卡，CEO Jensen Huang 把 CUDA 当作 10 年战略投资,2007-2012 年每年投入约 1 亿美元研发 CUDA 生态，而那时 CUDA 商业回报几乎为零。
这个决策在 NVIDIA 内部有争议，投资人多次质疑 CUDA 投入是否值得。
2012 年 AlexNet 用 GTX 580 训练 ImageNet,证明 GPU 训练深度网络可行，CUDA 投入开始回报。
2014 年 cuDNN 1.0 + 2015 年 TensorFlow + 2016 年 PyTorch,让 CUDA 成为深度学习算力垄断者，Huang 30 年的 CUDA 战略在 2020 年代彻底变现。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
CUDA 1.0 是 NVIDIA 从“游戏显卡公司”转向“AI 算力垄断者”的转折点。
今天 NVIDIA 市值 3 万亿美元，核心壁垒就是 CUDA 生态。
理解 2007 年 CUDA 1.0 → 2012 年 AlexNet → 2014 年 cuDNN → 2020 年 LLM 这条线，才能看清为什么 AMD、Intel、Google TPU 都难以撼动 NVIDIA 在 LLM 训练算力市场的地位。
events.source_name: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 release (2007-02-14); NVIDIA Tesla brand launch (2007)
events.card_summary_zh: CUDA 让开发者可以直接调用 GPU 进行通用计算，训练神经网络所需的并行算力从此变得可编程。
events.card_summary_en: CUDA allowed developers to directly program GPUs for general-purpose computing. This breakthrough made the massive parallel processing power required for training neural networks accessible and programmable.
events.summary_en: On February 14, 2007, NVIDIA released CUDA 1.0, supporting hardware like the GeForce 8 series, Quadro FX 4600/5600, and Tesla C870/G80. The release included the nvcc compiler, CUDA Runtime, cuBLAS, cuFFT, and CUDA GDB, allowing C developers to directly program highly parallel computations—such as matrix multiplications and convolutions—on GPUs. That same year, NVIDIA launched its Tesla brand, establishing a dedicated product line for high-performance computing and AI workloads. The CUDA SDK steadily matured, eventually leading to cuBLAS-XT in 2010 and cuDNN 1.0 in 2014, which became the foundational dependencies for modern deep learning frameworks.
events.context_en: When CUDA 1.0 launched, NVIDIA’s revenue relied almost entirely on gaming graphics cards. CEO Jensen Huang viewed CUDA as a decade-long strategic investment, reportedly spending around $100 million annually from 2007 to 2012 to build the ecosystem, despite generating almost zero commercial return during that period. This decision was controversial within NVIDIA, and investors repeatedly questioned whether the massive expenditure was justified. The turning point arrived in 2012 when the AlexNet architecture was trained on GTX 580 GPUs to win the ImageNet competition, proving the viability of GPUs for training deep neural networks and validating the CUDA investment. Subsequent developments—including the release of cuDNN 1.0 in 2014 and the rise of frameworks like TensorFlow in 2015 and PyTorch in 2016—cemented CUDA as the dominant compute platform for deep learning. Huang’s long-term strategic bet ultimately materialized in the 2020s, transforming the company into the primary engine of the global AI boom.
events.why_it_matters_en: The release of CUDA 1.0 marked the critical inflection point in NVIDIA’s transition from a gaming hardware company to the dominant force in AI compute. Today, the CUDA software ecosystem remains NVIDIA's most formidable competitive moat. Tracing the trajectory from CUDA 1.0 in 2007 to AlexNet in 2012, cuDNN in 2014, and the large language model explosion of the 2020s explains why competitors like AMD, Intel, and Google with its TPUs have struggled to displace NVIDIA's entrenched position in the AI training market.

events.title_zh: DARPA Urban Challenge:无人驾驶进入城市环境
events.title_en: DARPA Urban Challenge: Autonomous Driving Enters Urban Environment
events.summary_zh:
2007 年 11 月 3 日，DARPA 在加州 Victorville 举办 Urban Challenge。
赛道 96 公里城市道路，要求无人车遵守交通规则，在路口、环形交叉、并道、超车场景下与其他车辆和人类司机互动。
11 支队伍进入决赛，CMU Boss(Tartan Racing）第一，Stanford Junior 第二，Virginia Tech Odin 第三，MIT Talos 第六。
Boss 用 6 小时 53 分完成 96 公里，平均时速 14 公里。
这是无人车第一次在城市环境跑通完整交通规则。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Urban Challenge 的难点是动态环境决策。
2004 Grand Challenge 失败 → 2005 Grand Challenge 5 队完成 → 2007 Urban Challenge 6 队完成，三年三大步。
CMU Boss 团队由 Chris Urmson（后来 Waymo CEO）领军，用激光雷达 + 视觉 + 雷达 + 路径规划，处理了路口让行、并道、超车等城市场景。
Stanford Junior 团队由 Sebastian Thrun 领军，用类似方案，在并道决策上略保守，排第二。
Urmson 和 Thrun 都在 2009 年加入 Google Project Chauffeur,Urban Challenge 是 Waymo 的技术源头。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
Urban Challenge 是无人驾驶从“野外”进入“城市”的转折点。
它证明无人车可以在真实交通系统里行动，为 2009 年 Google 自动驾驶项目、2014 年特斯拉 Autopilot、2016 年 Waymo 独立、2018 年 Cruise 风险投资铺平道路。
今天无人驾驶圈的技术骨干，大多经过 2004-2007 三届 DARPA 挑战赛的训练。
events.source_name: DARPA Urban Challenge 2007 official report; Urmson et al. (2008) J. Field Robotics 25(10)
events.card_summary_zh: 无人车第一次在模拟城市道路中处理路口、并线和交通规则，自动驾驶从荒野测试进入真实交通逻辑。
events.card_summary_en: Autonomous vehicles successfully navigated intersections, merging, and traffic rules in a simulated city environment for the first time, shifting the focus of autonomous driving from off-road terrain to real-world traffic logic.
events.summary_en: On November 3, 2007, DARPA hosted the Urban Challenge in Victorville, California. The competition required autonomous vehicles to navigate a 96-kilometer simulated urban course while obeying traffic laws and interacting with other vehicles and human drivers at intersections, roundabouts, and merging lanes. Eleven teams reached the finals. Carnegie Mellon University’s Tartan Racing took first place with "Boss," completing the course in 6 hours and 53 minutes at an average speed of 14 km/h. Stanford University placed second, and Virginia Tech took third. This marked the first time autonomous vehicles successfully executed comprehensive traffic rules in an urban setting.
events.context_en: The primary technical hurdle of the Urban Challenge was dynamic environmental decision-making. The event represented a rapid progression in autonomous driving capabilities, advancing from the widespread failures of the 2004 Grand Challenge to five teams completing the 2005 off-road course, and finally to six teams finishing the 2007 urban course. The winning Carnegie Mellon team, led by future Waymo CEO Chris Urmson, utilized a combination of LiDAR, computer vision, radar, and advanced path planning to handle complex urban scenarios like yielding at intersections, merging, and passing. Stanford’s team, led by Sebastian Thrun, employed a similar architecture but adopted slightly more conservative merging algorithms, resulting in a second-place finish. Both Urmson and Thrun would go on to join Google's Project Chauffeur in 2009, making the technologies and talent developed for the Urban Challenge the direct foundational source for Waymo.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Urban Challenge marked a critical turning point, shifting autonomous driving research from off-road navigation to complex urban environments. By proving that autonomous vehicles could operate within a real-world traffic system, the competition paved the way for commercial milestones, including the launch of Google's self-driving project in 2009, Tesla's Autopilot in 2014, Waymo's spin-off in 2016, and major venture investments in Cruise by 2018. Furthermore, the 2004–2007 DARPA challenges served as the ultimate training ground for the industry, producing the core technical leadership that continues to drive autonomous vehicle development today.
events.source_author: DARPA Urban Challenge 2007 official report; Urmson et al. (institutional record)

events.title_zh: Google Project Chauffeur:工业级自动驾驶启动
events.title_en: Google Project Chauffeur: Industrial Autonomous Driving Launched
events.summary_zh:
2009 年 1 月 17 日，Google X 启动 Project Chauffeur 自动驾驶项目，Sebastian Thrun(Stanford Junior 团队领军）和 Chris Urmson(CMU Boss 团队领军）共同主导。
团队最初 10 人，包括 DARPA Grand Challenge 老将 Mike Montemerlo、Anthony Levandowski、Bryan Salesky 等。
2010 年 10 月第一代无人车 Toyota Prius 改装版在旧金山公开路测,2012 年 5 月 Nevada 颁发第一张无人车牌照。
2016 年 12 月项目分拆为 Waymo 独立子公司，John Krafcik 任 CEO。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Google 自动驾驶的启动是 Larry Page 直接推动。
Page 2007 年看到 Urban Challenge 后,2008 年邀请 Thrun 到 Google X 评估“自动驾驶是否 5 年可商业化”。
Thrun 团队评估结论是“10 年可商业化”,Page 决定投入,2009 年 1 月 Project Chauffeur 启动。
Google 选择“直接做 L4 全无人驾驶”,跳过 L2/L3 渐进路线，这个决策让 Waymo 在 2009-2018 年技术领先但商业化缓慢，和 Tesla Autopilot 2014 年“L2 先量产、积累数据”的路线形成对比。
2020 年 Waymo 在 Phoenix 开放全无人出租车服务，比 Tesla FSD 早 4 年实现 L4 商业运营，但 Waymo 扩张速度远低于 Tesla FSD 用户基数。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
Google Project Chauffeur 是现代工业级自动驾驶的零时刻。
Waymo、Cruise、Zoox、Pony.ai、文远知行的技术骨干，大多经过 Google Chauffeur 的训练。
今天无人驾驶圈讨论的“L2 vs L4”“数据飞轮 vs 算法突破”“渐进 vs 跳跃”,在 2009-2014 年 Google 内部都已经预演过一次。
events.source_name: Google Project Chauffeur (2009-01); Waymo 2016 spin-off; Thrun interviews
events.card_summary_zh: Google 把自动驾驶从竞赛原型变成长期工业项目，后来独立成 Waymo 并开启商业无人驾驶路线。
events.card_summary_en: Google transitioned autonomous driving from competition prototypes to a long-term industrial project, later spinning it off as Waymo and pioneering the commercial driverless trajectory.
events.summary_en: On January 17, 2009, Google X launched Project Chauffeur, an autonomous driving initiative co-led by Sebastian Thrun (leader of Stanford's Junior team) and Chris Urmson (leader of CMU's Boss team). The initial 10-person team included DARPA Grand Challenge veterans like Mike Montemerlo, Anthony Levandowski, and Bryan Salesky. In October 2010, the first-generation self-driving car—a modified Toyota Prius—began public road testing in San Francisco. By May 2012, Nevada had issued the first autonomous vehicle license plate. In December 2016, the project was spun off into an independent subsidiary named Waymo, with John Krafcik serving as CEO.
events.context_en: The launch of Google's autonomous driving initiative was directly driven by Larry Page.
