After observing the DARPA Urban Challenge in 2007, Page invited Thrun to Google X in 2008 to assess whether autonomous driving could be commercialized within five years. Thrun's team concluded it would take ten years, prompting Page to commit to the investment and launch Project Chauffeur in January 2009. Google chose to pursue Level 4 (L4) fully autonomous driving directly, skipping the gradual L2/L3 progression. This decision allowed Waymo to maintain a technical lead from 2009 to 2018, though commercialization was slow. This contrasted sharply with Tesla Autopilot's 2014 strategy of mass-producing L2 systems first to accumulate data. In 2020, Waymo launched a fully driverless robotaxi service in Phoenix, achieving L4 commercial operations four years ahead of Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) rollout, although Waymo's expansion rate has remained far below Tesla's FSD user base.
events.why_it_matters_en: Google Project Chauffeur marks the genesis of modern industrial-grade autonomous driving. The technical backbone of leading autonomous vehicle companies—including Waymo, Cruise, Zoox, Pony.ai, and WeRide—largely consists of veterans trained during the Chauffeur era. Furthermore, the core debates dominating the autonomous driving industry today, such as L2 versus L4 autonomy, data flywheels versus algorithmic breakthroughs, and gradual progression versus direct leaps, were already rehearsed internally at Google between 2009 and 2014.

events.title_zh: Fei-Fei Li ImageNet:视觉识别的标准基准
events.title_en: Fei-Fei Li ImageNet: Standard Benchmark for Visual Recognition
events.summary_zh:
2009 年 6 月 20 日，Fei-Fei Li 团队在 CVPR 2009 发表《ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database》，正式发布 ImageNet 数据集。
数据集基于 WordNet 名词层级，通过 Amazon Mechanical Turk 众包标注，最终收录 1400 万张图像、21841 个类别，每类约 500-1000 张。
2010 年 ILSVRC(ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge）启动，用 1000 类 + 120 万训练图 + 5 万验证图 + 15 万测试图，成为视觉识别的标准基准。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Fei-Fei Li 2007 年在普林斯顿开始 ImageNet 项目，初衷是“算法再好，没数据也白搭”。
项目初期经费紧张，Li 把自己工资拿出来付 Mechanical Turk 标注费，用了 167 个国家 49,000 名工人,2.5 年完成 1400 万张图标注。
2009 年 CVPR 论文最初被主流视觉圈忽视,2010 年 ILSVRC 比赛启动后，ImageNet 才成为视觉识别的公共基准。
2012 年 AlexNet 在 ILSVRC 上把 top-5 错误率从 26.2% 降到 15.3%,成为深度学习时代的引爆点。
Fei-Fei Li 后来在 Google Cloud、斯坦福 HAI 工作，ImageNet 至今仍是视觉 AI 史最重要的一次数据基础设施建设。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
ImageNet 是深度学习时代的引爆点。
没有 ImageNet,就没有 AlexNet 2012 年的突破，也没有 2012-2020 年 CNN 工程化的工业基础。
今天 LLM 圈讨论的“数据集规模 vs 算法复杂度”“基准饱和”“数据集偏见”,在 ImageNet 时代都已经预演过一次。
理解 ImageNet,才能看清为什么 LLM 圈今天对 Common Crawl、C4、RedPajama 等大规模语料库的投入和 2009 年 Li 团队对图像数据的投入是同一类工程决策。
events.source_name: Deng, J. et al. (2009) CVPR; Russakovsky et al. (2015) IJCV 115(3):211-252
missing_terms: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛
events.card_summary_zh: ImageNet 用千万级标注图像建立统一赛场，让计算机视觉第一次能够按同一尺度持续比较和进步。
events.card_summary_en: ImageNet established a unified arena with tens of millions of annotated images, enabling the computer vision field to consistently measure and track progress on a single scale for the first time.
events.summary_en: On June 20, 2009, Fei-Fei Li's team officially introduced the ImageNet dataset by publishing "ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database" at CVPR 2009. Structured around the WordNet noun hierarchy, the dataset was annotated via crowdsourcing on Amazon Mechanical Turk. It ultimately amassed 14 million images across 21,841 categories, with roughly 500 to 1,000 images per class. In 2010, the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC) was launched. Featuring 1,000 categories, 1.2 million training images, 50,000 validation images, and 150,000 test images, ILSVRC quickly became the standard benchmark for visual recognition.
events.context_en: Fei-Fei Li initiated the ImageNet project at Princeton University in 2007, driven by the conviction that even the best algorithms are useless without massive amounts of data. Facing severe funding shortages in the project's early stages, Li used her own salary to pay Amazon Mechanical Turk workers. Over two and a half years, 49,000 workers from 167 countries annotated 14 million images. Initially, the 2009 CVPR paper was largely overlooked by the mainstream computer vision community. It was not until the launch of the ILSVRC competition in 2010 that ImageNet gained traction as a public benchmark. The dataset's true watershed moment arrived in 2012, when the AlexNet architecture used it to drop the top-5 error rate from 26.2% to 15.3%, igniting the deep learning era. Li later held prominent roles at Google Cloud and Stanford HAI, but ImageNet remains arguably the most critical piece of data infrastructure in the history of visual AI.
events.why_it_matters_en: ImageNet served as the catalyst for the deep learning revolution. Without it, the 2012 AlexNet breakthrough and the subsequent industrialization of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) from 2012 to 2020 would not have been possible. Furthermore, contemporary debates in the large language model (LLM) community regarding dataset scale versus algorithmic complexity, benchmark saturation, and dataset bias were all foreshadowed during the ImageNet era. Understanding ImageNet provides crucial context for why today's massive investments in text corpora like Common Crawl, C4, and RedPajama mirror the foundational engineering decisions Li's team made for image data in 2009.

events.title_zh: IBM Watson 击败 Jeopardy! 冠军:问答 AI 高峰
events.title_en: IBM Watson Beats Jeopardy! Champions: QA AI Peak
events.summary_zh:
2011 年 2 月 14-16 日，IBM Watson 在 Jeopardy! 三集特别节目中以 77,147 美元击败卫冕冠军 Ken Jennings(24,000）和 Brad Rutter(21,600）。
Watson 由 David Ferrucci 2006-2011 年领导开发，用 DeepQA 架构：问题分析 + 候选生成 + 证据检索 + 置信度排序，在 200M 页结构化文档上做并行检索,3 秒内给出答案。
Watson 硬件是 90 台 IBM Power 750 服务器,2880 个 Power7 核心,16TB 内存。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Watson 是 IBM 100 年史最大公关投入，IBM 2006-2011 年投入约 10 亿美元开发。
Ferrucci 团队选择“集成 + 工程化”路线，用 100+ 算法并行回答同一问题，然后投票选出置信度最高的答案。
Watson 在 Jeopardy! 表现惊人，但 Ferrucci 2012 年离开 IBM,Watson 后续商业化（医疗、金融、法律）进展缓慢。
IBM 2018 年关闭 Watson for Oncology 多个客户，Watson Health 2022 年以 10 亿美元卖给 Francisco Partners。
Watson 的“问答 AI”路线被 2018 年 BERT + 2020 年 GPT-3 彻底颠覆。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
Watson 是“符号 AI + 工程集成”路线最后的工程高峰。
它在 Jeopardy! 上的胜利和 Deep Blue 1997 击败卡斯帕罗夫一样，证明窄场景 AI 能战胜人类专家。
但 Watson 商业化失败也证明“符号 AI + 工程集成”路线不可扩展，为 2012 年 AlexNet + 2018 年 BERT + 2020 年 GPT-3 的“统计学习 + 大规模预训练”路线让路。
events.source_name: IBM Watson Jeopardy! (2011-02-14-16); Ferrucci, D. (2012) AI Magazine 33(1)
events.card_summary_zh: Watson 在开放领域问答节目中击败两位冠军，展示了搜索、语言处理与工程集成的系统力量。
events.card_summary_en: IBM Watson defeated two human champions in the open-domain trivia game Jeopardy!, demonstrating the systemic power of integrating search, natural language processing, and massive engineering.
events.summary_en: In a three-episode Jeopardy! special, IBM Watson defeated reigning champions Ken Jennings and Brad Rutter, finishing with $77,147 against their $24,000 and $21,600, respectively. Developed between 2006 and 2011 under the leadership of David Ferrucci, Watson utilized the DeepQA architecture, which combined question analysis, candidate generation, evidence retrieval, and confidence scoring. The system performed parallel retrieval across 200 million pages of documents to deliver answers within three seconds. Watson was powered by 90 IBM Power 750 servers, featuring 2,880 Power7 cores and 16TB of RAM.
events.context_en: Watson represented the largest public relations investment in IBM's 100-year history, with the company spending approximately $1 billion on its development from 2006 to 2011. Ferrucci's team opted for an integration and engineering-heavy approach, deploying over 100 algorithms to answer the same question in parallel before voting on the response with the highest confidence score. Despite its stunning performance on Jeopardy!, Watson's subsequent commercialization efforts in healthcare, finance, and law progressed slowly, and Ferrucci left IBM in 2012. By 2018, IBM had scaled back Watson for Oncology, and in 2022, it sold Watson Health to Francisco Partners for $1 billion. Ultimately, Watson's highly engineered approach to question-answering AI was entirely superseded by the statistical learning and large-scale pre-training paradigms introduced by models like BERT in 2018 and GPT-3 in 2020.
events.why_it_matters_en: Watson stands as the final engineering peak for the 'symbolic AI plus systems integration' trajectory. Much like Deep Blue's 1997 victory over Garry Kasparov, Watson's triumph on Jeopardy! proved that AI could defeat human experts within narrow, highly defined domains. However, its subsequent commercial failures demonstrated that this heavily engineered approach was fundamentally unscalable. This limitation ultimately paved the way for the industry's shift toward the statistical learning and large-scale pre-training paradigm, driven by breakthroughs like AlexNet in 2012, BERT in 2018, and GPT-3 in 2020.

events.title_zh: Apple Siri 在 iPhone 4S 发布:消费级语音助手诞生
events.title_en: Apple Siri Launched on iPhone 4S: Consumer Voice Assistant Born
events.summary_zh:
2011 年 10 月 4 日，Apple 在 iPhone 4S 发布会推出 Siri 语音助手,10 月 14 日 iPhone 4S 上市，Siri 正式面向消费者。
Siri 1.0 用 Nuance 语音识别 + 自研自然语言理解 + 25 类内置服务（短信、电话、日历、地图、Wolfram Alpha),用户用自然语言对话，Siri 返回结果或调用 App。
Siri 开启了 Alexa(2014）、Google Assistant(2016）、Cortana(2014）、Bixby(2017）的语音助手时代。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Siri 1.0 的技术来自 Apple 2010 年收购的 Siri Inc. + 2010 年收购的 Polar Rose（面部识别）。
Steve Jobs 2011 年 10 月 5 日去世（发布 iPhone 4S 第二天),Siri 成为 Jobs 时代 Apple 最后一个重要 AI 产品。
Siri 1.0 在 iPhone 4S 上响应时间 3-5 秒，依赖云端 Apple 数据中心及第三方云服务。
Siri 2011-2018 年技术进展缓慢，Google Assistant 2016 年超越 Siri,Amazon Alexa 2014 年成为智能音箱市场领先者。
Apple 2024 年 Apple Intelligence 用 LLM 重构 Siri。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
Siri 是消费级语音助手的起点。
它证明 AI 语音助手可以作为日常工具进入消费市场，为 2014 年 Amazon Alexa/Echo、2016 年 Google Assistant/Home、2024 年 AI Pin/Rabbit R1 等“对话式 AI 硬件”铺路。
理解 Siri → Alexa → Google Assistant → ChatGPT Voice 这条线，可看出为什么 LLM 时代语音交互比文本交互更有商业想象空间。
events.source_name: Apple Siri on iPhone 4S launch (2011-10-04); Siri Inc. acquisition (2010-04-28)
events.card_summary_zh: Siri 被装进数百万部手机，语音交互第一次从研究演示变成普通人每天都能使用的产品。
events.card_summary_en: Integrated into millions of smartphones, Siri transformed voice interaction from a research demonstration into a daily tool for everyday consumers.
events.summary_en: Apple introduced the Siri voice assistant alongside the iPhone 4S, officially bringing conversational AI to consumers. Siri 1.0 combined Nuance's speech recognition with proprietary natural language understanding, integrating 25 built-in services including messaging, phone calls, calendars, maps, and Wolfram Alpha. Users could speak in natural language, prompting Siri to return results or invoke specific applications. This release catalyzed the modern era of voice assistants, paving the way for competitors like Amazon Alexa (2014), Microsoft Cortana (2014), Google Assistant (2016), and Samsung Bixby (2017).
events.context_en: The foundational technology for Siri 1.0 stemmed from Apple's 2010 acquisition of Siri Inc., supplemented by its purchase of the facial recognition firm Polar Rose. Steve Jobs passed away the day after the iPhone 4S announcement, making Siri the final major AI product launched under his leadership. Early performance was constrained by the era's infrastructure; Siri 1.0 required three to five seconds to respond, relying heavily on Apple's cloud data centers and third-party services. Following its launch, Siri's technical development progressed slowly between 2011 and 2018. This stagnation allowed competitors to capture significant market share, with Amazon Alexa dominating the smart speaker market from 2014 and Google Assistant surpassing Siri's capabilities by 2016. Apple eventually rebuilt Siri using large language models with the introduction of Apple Intelligence in 2024.
events.why_it_matters_en: Siri marks the starting point for consumer-grade voice assistants. It proved that AI-driven voice interfaces could successfully enter the mass market as daily utility tools, laying the groundwork for conversational AI hardware like the Amazon Echo, Google Home, and later devices such as the Humane AI Pin and Rabbit R1. Tracing the trajectory from Siri to Alexa, Google Assistant, and eventually ChatGPT's advanced voice mode illustrates the enduring commercial appeal of voice interaction. This lineage highlights why voice interfaces continue to offer broader commercial possibilities than text alone in the era of large language models.
events.source_author: Apple Siri on iPhone 4S launch (institutional record)

events.title_zh: AlexNet 在 NIPS 2012 引爆:深度学习时代起点
events.title_en: AlexNet at NIPS 2012: Deep Learning Era Begins
events.summary_zh:
2012 年 12 月，Alex Krizhevsky、Ilya Sutskever、Geoffrey Hinton 在 NIPS 2012 论文集发表论文《ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks》（ILSVRC 2012 结果于 10 月公布，top-5 错误率 15.3% vs 第二名 26.2%）。
AlexNet 在 ImageNet ILSVRC 2012 把 top-5 错误率从 26.2%（传统 CV）降到 15.3%,领先第二名 10.8 个百分点。
AlexNet 用 8 层 CNN(5 卷积 + 3 全连接）、650K 神经元、60M 参数、630M 连接，在 2 块 NVIDIA GTX 580 GPU 上训练 5-6 天。
关键创新:ReLU 激活、Dropout 正则化、数据增强、GPU 并行训练。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
AlexNet 是 Hinton 多伦多团队 2006 DBN 论文的工程化兑现。
Krizhevsky 2010 年开始用 GPU 训练 CNN（参考 Raina-Ng 2009 论文),2012 年 ImageNet 数据集成熟 + GTX 580 GPU 算力 + ReLU/Dropout 工程技巧，三个条件凑齐。
AlexNet 提交 ILSVRC 2012 时，Hinton 团队本以为“CNN 反叛主流 CV”会被质疑，结果 top-5 错误率 15.3% vs 第二名 26.2% 的差距太大，整个 CV 圈 6 个月内转向深度学习。
Sutskever 后来 2014 年加入 Google Brain,2015 年联合创立 OpenAI,2024 年联合创立 SSI(Safe Superintelligence Inc.）。
Krizhevsky 2015 年加入 Google,2017 年离开 AI 圈，AlexNet 是他唯一的爆款论文。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
AlexNet 是深度学习时代的起点。
2012 年之后的 AI 史，VGG、GoogLeNet、ResNet、Transformer、BERT、GPT、Stable Diffusion、AlphaFold,都建立在 AlexNet 确立的“CNN/Transformer + GPU + 大数据 + ReLU/Dropout”范式上。
理解 2012 AlexNet → 2014 GAN → 2015 ResNet → 2017 Transformer → 2018 BERT → 2020 GPT-3 → 2022 ChatGPT 这条线，可看出深度学习不是 2012 年凭空爆发的，而是 2006 Hinton DBN + 2009 GPU + 2009 ImageNet 三个条件成熟的工程结果。
events.source_name: Krizhevsky, A., Sutskever, I., Hinton, G. (2012) NIPS; ILSVRC 2012 results
missing_terms: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛
events.card_summary_zh: 关键创新:ReLU 激活、Dropout 正则化、数据增强、GPU 并行训练；AlexNet 是深度学习时代的起点。
events.card_summary_en: Introducing key innovations like ReLU activation, dropout regularization, and GPU parallel training, AlexNet marked the definitive starting point of the modern deep learning era.
events.summary_en: In December 2012, Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, and Geoffrey Hinton published their landmark paper, "ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks," at NIPS. Earlier that October, their model, AlexNet, dominated the ILSVRC 2012 competition by reducing the top-5 error rate to 15.3%—crushing the second-place traditional computer vision entry at 26.2%. The architecture featured an eight-layer convolutional neural network (five convolutional and three fully connected layers) with 60 million parameters. Trained over five to six days on two NVIDIA GTX 580 GPUs, AlexNet introduced critical engineering innovations, including ReLU activation, dropout regularization, data augmentation, and parallel GPU training.
events.context_en: AlexNet represented the engineering realization of concepts Geoffrey Hinton’s University of Toronto team had been developing since their 2006 work on deep belief networks. By 2010, Krizhevsky had begun training CNNs on GPUs, building on earlier research by Rajat Raina and Andrew Ng. By 2012, three crucial elements aligned: the maturity of the large-scale ImageNet dataset, the computational power of GTX 580 GPUs, and practical engineering techniques like ReLU and dropout. When submitting to ILSVRC 2012, Hinton’s team anticipated skepticism from a computer vision community dominated by traditional feature-engineering methods. Instead, the massive performance gap—a 15.3% error rate compared to the runner-up's 26.2%—was undeniable, prompting the entire computer vision field to pivot toward deep learning within six months. The authors' trajectories diverged significantly afterward. Ilya Sutskever joined Google Brain in 2014, co-founded OpenAI in 2015, and later co-founded Safe Superintelligence (SSI) in 2024. Alex Krizhevsky joined Google in 2015 but left the AI industry in 2017, making AlexNet his singular, albeit monumental, blockbuster paper.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlexNet is widely recognized as the foundational breakthrough that launched the modern deep learning era. The subsequent history of AI—spanning architectures like VGG, ResNet, and Transformers, to models like GPT, Stable Diffusion, and AlphaFold—was built upon the paradigm AlexNet established: neural networks combined with GPU compute, massive datasets, and optimization techniques like ReLU and dropout. Tracing the trajectory from AlexNet to ChatGPT reveals that the deep learning revolution did not emerge in a vacuum in 2012. Rather, it was the culmination of converging prerequisites: algorithmic advances from 2006, the advent of GPU acceleration, and the creation of large-scale datasets like ImageNet.
events.source_author: A. Krizhevsky, I. Sutskever, G. Hinton

events.title_zh: Mikolov word2vec:词向量与分布式表示普及
events.title_en: Mikolov word2vec: Word Embeddings Popularized
events.summary_zh:
2013 年 1 月 16 日，Tomas Mikolov、Kai Chen、Greg Corrado、Jeff Dean 在 arXiv 发表论文《Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space》，后发表于 ICLR 2013。
word2vec 用 100 维向量表示词，在 1000 亿词 Google News 语料上训练，CBOW 和 Skip-gram 两种模型 + Hierarchical Softmax + Negative Sampling 两种训练技巧，训练时间从 RNNLM 的几周降到几小时。
word2vec 的“king - man + woman = queen”类比实验，让“分布式表示 + 向量算术”成为 NLP 标准工具，为 2018 BERT、2020 GPT-3、2022 ChatGPT 的词嵌入层铺路。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Mikolov 2010 年在 Brno University 读博时开发 RNNLM,用 RNN 训练语言模型,2011 年加入 Google 后继续优化。
word2vec 的核心洞察是“用浅层模型 + 大数据”能超过“深层模型 + 小数据”,和 Hinton 团队当时主流的“深度网络”路线不同。
Mikolov 2014 年离开 Google 加入 Facebook FAIR,2017 年回到捷克 CTU,2020 年加入 CIIRC。
word2vec 之后,2014 年 Pennington et al. GloVe(Stanford）、2014 年 Bojanowski et al. fastText(Facebook）、2018 年 ELMo、2018 年 BERT、2019 年 GPT-2 把词向量路线扩展到上下文相关表示，但 word2vec 至今仍是 NLP 教学 + 工程基线。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
word2vec 是“分布式表示 + 大规模语料预训练”范式的早期工程化。
今天 LLM 圈讨论的“词嵌入”“上下文表示”“预训练”,在 2013 年 word2vec 上都有早期版本。
理解 word2vec → GloVe → ELMo → BERT → GPT 这条线，可看出为什么“用大规模语料预训练表示”是 NLP 的核心范式，以及为什么 2018 年 BERT 之后的“上下文相关表示”比 word2vec 静态表示更强大。
events.source_name: Mikolov, T. et al. (2013) ICLR 2013; arXiv:1301.3781
events.card_summary_zh: word2vec 把词语映射成可计算的向量，“国王减男人加女人约等于女王”让语义关系第一次直观可见。
events.card_summary_en: The word2vec framework mapped words into computable vectors, famously demonstrating that "king - man + woman ≈ queen." This breakthrough made semantic relationships intuitively visible for the first time.
events.summary_en: On January 16, 2013, Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, and Jeff Dean published "Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space" on arXiv, later accepted at ICLR 2013. The word2vec framework represented words as 100-dimensional vectors, training on a 100-billion-word Google News corpus. By combining CBOW and Skip-gram architectures with hierarchical softmax and negative sampling techniques, it reduced training time from weeks to hours. Its famous "king - man + woman = queen" analogy experiment established distributed representations and vector arithmetic as standard NLP tools, paving the way for the embedding layers in BERT, GPT-3, and ChatGPT.
events.context_en: Tomas Mikolov previously developed RNNLM (Recurrent Neural Network Language Model) during his PhD at Brno University in 2010, continuing to optimize it after joining Google in 2011. The core insight behind word2vec was that a shallow model trained on massive datasets could outperform deep models trained on smaller datasets—a departure from the deep neural network trajectory championed by Geoffrey Hinton's team at the time. Mikolov left Google for Facebook's FAIR in 2014, later returning to the Czech Technical University (CTU) in 2017 and joining CIIRC in 2020. Following word2vec, the field rapidly expanded with Stanford's GloVe (Pennington et al., 2014) and Facebook's fastText (Bojanowski et al., 2014). Eventually, models like ELMo (2018), BERT (2018), and GPT-2 (2019) evolved this word vector approach into context-dependent representations. Despite these advancements, word2vec remains a foundational baseline in both NLP education and engineering today.
events.why_it_matters_en: Word2vec represents an early, highly successful engineering implementation of the "distributed representation plus large-scale corpus pre-training" paradigm. The concepts of word embeddings, contextual representations, and pre-training discussed in today's large language model ecosystem all have early roots in the 2013 word2vec framework. Tracing the trajectory from word2vec to GloVe, ELMo, BERT, and GPT illustrates why pre-training representations on massive corpora became the central paradigm of NLP. It also highlights why the context-dependent representations introduced by BERT in 2018 ultimately proved far more powerful than the static representations pioneered by word2vec.

events.title_zh: DeepMind DQN:深度强化学习首次成功
events.title_en: DeepMind DQN: First Deep Reinforcement Learning Success
events.summary_zh:
2013 年 12 月 19 日，DeepMind 团队（Volodymyr Mnih、Koray Kavukcuoglu、David Silver、Alex Graves、Ioannis Antonoglou、Daan Wierstra、Martin Riedmiller）在 NIPS 2013 Deep Learning Workshop 发表论文《Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning》。
DQN 用 CNN + Q-learning,从原始像素输入学习 49 种 Atari 游戏，其中 29 种超过人类专家水平。
DQN 关键创新:Experience Replay + Target Network,解决 Q-learning 在深度网络上的训练不稳定问题。
2015 年 2 月 Nature 518:529-533 完整版发表，DQN 在 49 种 Atari 游戏中 22 种超人类。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
DeepMind 2010 年由 Demis Hassabis、Shane Legg、Mustafa Suleyman 在伦敦创办,2014 年 1 月 Google 以 6.5 亿美元收购。
DQN 是 DeepMind 在 Google 收购前的关键证明：深度学习 + 强化学习可以解决通用游戏 AI。
Silver 团队 2013-2019 年深耕 DRL,2015 DQN Nature → 2016 AlphaGo → 2017 AlphaGo Zero → 2018 AlphaZero → 2019 MuZero,DRL 路线达到第一个高峰。
DQN 之后 2015-2020 年，DeepMind + OpenAI + 学术圈把 DRL 扩展到机器人、自动驾驶、对话、推荐、视觉等场景，但 2020 年后 LLM 路线 + RLHF 替代纯 DRL 成为主流。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
DQN 是“深度学习 + 强化学习”结合的起点。
今天 LLM 圈讨论的“RLHF”“奖励模型”“策略优化”,在 2013 年 DQN + 2017 PPO + 2018 TRPO + 2020 ILQL 上都有早期版本。
理解 DQN → AlphaGo → AlphaZero → MuZero → RLHF 这条线，可看出为什么 OpenAI 2015-2019 年深耕 DRL,以及为什么 2020 年 OpenAI 用 RLHF 训练 GPT-3 是 7 年 DRL 工程积累的工程变现。
events.source_name: Mnih, V. et al. (2013) NIPS Deep Learning Workshop; (2015) Nature 518:529-533
events.card_summary_zh: DQN 只看屏幕像素就学会多款 Atari 游戏，深度学习与强化学习第一次形成可扩展的统一方法。
events.card_summary_en: By learning to play multiple Atari games directly from raw screen pixels, DeepMind's Deep Q-Network (DQN) established the first scalable, unified approach combining deep learning with reinforcement learning.
events.summary_en: On December 19, 2013, a DeepMind team including Volodymyr Mnih, David Silver, and others presented "Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning" at the NIPS Deep Learning Workshop. The Deep Q-Network (DQN) combined convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with Q-learning to master Atari games directly from raw pixel inputs. To resolve the training instability of Q-learning in deep networks, the team introduced key innovations like experience replay and target networks. The model learned 49 Atari games, exceeding human expert levels in 29 of them. A complete version published in Nature in February 2015 reported superhuman performance in 22 of the 49 games.
events.context_en:
Founded in London in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg, and Mustafa Suleyman, DeepMind used DQN as a critical proof of concept before its $650 million acquisition by Google in January 2014. The breakthrough demonstrated that combining deep learning with reinforcement learning (DRL) could effectively solve general game AI. Following this success, David Silver's team heavily focused on DRL from 2013 to 2019, driving a trajectory that peaked with the 2015 Nature publication, AlphaGo in 2016, AlphaGo Zero in 2017, AlphaZero in 2018, and MuZero in 2019.

Between 2015 and 2020, DeepMind, OpenAI, and the broader academic community expanded DRL applications into robotics, autonomous driving, dialogue systems, recommendation engines, and computer vision. However, after 2020, the pure DRL paradigm was largely superseded in the mainstream by the rise of large language models (LLMs) combined with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF).
events.why_it_matters_en: DQN marks the foundational starting point for the integration of deep learning and reinforcement learning. The concepts dominating today's LLM landscape—such as RLHF, reward models, and policy optimization—trace their early iterations back to the 2013 DQN, alongside subsequent milestones like PPO (2017), TRPO (2018), and ILQL (2020). Tracing the lineage from DQN through the AlphaGo series to modern RLHF reveals why organizations like OpenAI invested so heavily in DRL between 2015 and 2019. Ultimately, OpenAI's successful application of RLHF to train GPT-3 in 2020 was the direct commercial realization of seven years of accumulated DRL engineering expertise.

events.title_zh: Goodfellow GAN:生成式 AI 的早期突破
events.title_en: Goodfellow GAN: Early Generative AI Breakthrough
events.summary_zh:
2014 年 6 月 10 日，Ian Goodfellow 等人在 NIPS 2014 发表论文《Generative Adversarial Nets》。
GAN 用 Generator + Discriminator 对抗训练，Generator 从噪声生成图像，Discriminator 判断图像真伪，两者博弈达到 Nash 均衡时 Generator 能生成逼真图像。
GAN 在 MNIST、TFD、CIFAR-10 上生成质量超过 VAE 和 Boltzmann Machine,为后续 2015 DCGAN、2017 CycleGAN、2018 StyleGAN、2019 BigGAN、2021 StyleGAN-ADA、2024 GAN+Diffusion 混合路线铺路。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
GAN 的灵感来自 Goodfellow 2014 年在 Montreal 酒吧和朋友讨论“用神经网络生成图像”的问题。
他回家后用几小时写出第一个 GAN 实现，在 MNIST 上 work,第二天告诉导师 Bengio,Bengio 让他立即写成论文。
GAN 论文 2014-2020 年被引用超过 5 万次，但 GAN 训练不稳定的问题（Mode Collapse、收敛困难）困扰学术界 8 年,2020 年 StyleGAN-ADA 才让 GAN 训练稳定。
GAN 在 2017-2022 年是图像生成主流,2022 年后被 Stable Diffusion(2022 年）等扩散模型替代。
GAN 路线对 LLM 圈的意义在“对抗训练”概念，RLHF 训练的 Reward Model 本质上是 GAN 的 Discriminator 思想。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
GAN 是“生成式 AI”的早期突破。
今天 LLM 圈讨论的“生成模型”“对抗训练”“RLHF”“AI 生成内容检测”,在 2014 年 GAN 上都有早期版本。
理解 GAN → StyleGAN → Diffusion → DALL-E 2 → Stable Diffusion → Midjourney v6 这条线，可看出为什么 2022 年 Stable Diffusion 之后图像生成从 GAN 转向 Diffusion,以及为什么 GAN 的“对抗训练”思想仍然影响 LLM 对齐路线。
events.source_name: Goodfellow, I. et al. (2014) NIPS 2014; arXiv:1406.2661
events.card_summary_zh: Goodfellow GAN：生成式 AI 的早期突破；GAN 是“生成式 AI”的早期突破。
events.card_summary_en: Ian Goodfellow and colleagues introduced Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), marking an early foundational breakthrough in generative AI through adversarial training.
events.summary_en: On June 10, 2014, Ian Goodfellow and co-authors published "Generative Adversarial Nets," later presented at NIPS 2014. The paper introduced a novel framework using adversarial training between two neural networks: a generator that creates images from noise, and a discriminator that evaluates their authenticity. Through this minimax game, the generator learns to produce highly realistic images as the system approaches a Nash equilibrium. Demonstrating superior generation quality over Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) and Boltzmann Machines on datasets like MNIST, TFD, and CIFAR-10, GANs laid the groundwork for subsequent architectures, including DCGAN, CycleGAN, StyleGAN, and modern GAN-diffusion hybrid models.
events.context_en: The inspiration for GANs famously struck Ian Goodfellow during a 2014 discussion with friends at a Montreal bar about generating images with neural networks. Returning home, he coded the first GAN implementation in just a few hours. After it successfully worked on the MNIST dataset, he shared the results with his advisor, Yoshua Bengio, who urged him to write the paper immediately. While the resulting publication garnered over 50,000 citations between 2014 and 2020, the architecture was plagued by training instabilities—such as mode collapse and convergence difficulties—that challenged researchers for years until advancements like StyleGAN-ADA emerged in 2020. GANs dominated image generation from 2017 to 2022 before being largely superseded by diffusion models like Stable Diffusion. However, the core concept of adversarial training remains highly relevant; the reward models used in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) for modern large language models conceptually echo the discriminator mechanism introduced by GANs.
events.why_it_matters_en: GANs represent a foundational breakthrough in generative AI. Many concepts central to today's AI landscape—including generative modeling, adversarial training, and AI-generated content detection—trace their early implementations back to the 2014 GAN framework. Tracing the trajectory from early GANs through StyleGAN to modern diffusion models like DALL-E 2, Stable Diffusion, and Midjourney illustrates both the architectural shift in image generation and the enduring legacy of adversarial training. Even as diffusion models have overtaken GANs in visual generation, the adversarial paradigm continues to deeply influence alignment strategies and reward modeling in contemporary large language models.

events.title_zh: Sutskever Seq2Seq:端到端机器翻译范式确立
events.title_en: Sutskever Seq2Seq: End-to-End Translation Paradigm Established
events.summary_zh:
2014 年 9 月 10 日，Ilya Sutskever、Oriol Vinyals、Quoc Le 在 NeurIPS 2014 发表论文《Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks》。
Seq2Seq 用 2 个 LSTM(Encoder + Decoder）做端到端机器翻译，在 WMT-14 英法翻译上 BLEU 34.8,超过传统统计机器翻译 33.3(SMT）。
Seq2Seq 关键创新:(1）端到端训练;(2) Encoder 把输入序列编码为固定长度向量;(3) Decoder 从该向量生成输出序列;(4）输入序列逆序 + 4 层 LSTM + beam search。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Seq2Seq 是 Sutskever 在 Google Brain 的工作，他和 Hinton 团队 2012 年 AlexNet 之后转向 NLP。
Seq2Seq 把“端到端学习”从图像分类扩展到序列生成，为 2015 Attention(Bahdanau et al.)→ 2017 Transformer(Vaswani et al.)→ 2018 BERT → 2020 GPT-3 铺路。
Sutskever 2015 年离开 Google 联合创办 OpenAI,担任 Chief Scientist,2024 年 5 月离开 OpenAI 联合创立 SSI(Safe Superintelligence Inc.）。
Seq2Seq 之后，Google 2016 年发布 GNMT(Google Neural Machine Translation),把 Google 翻译从 SMT 切换到 NMT,翻译质量大幅提升，这是 Seq2Seq 路线第一个大规模商业应用。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
Seq2Seq 是“端到端序列建模”范式的源头。
今天 LLM 圈讨论的“Encoder-Decoder”“生成式模型”“翻译 + 摘要 + 对话”,在 2014 年 Seq2Seq 上都有早期版本。
理解 Seq2Seq → Attention → Transformer → BERT/GPT 这条线，可看出为什么 2017 年 Transformer 是 NLP 的关键转折，以及为什么 2018 年 BERT 和 GPT 两种路线都建立在 Seq2Seq + Attention 之上。
events.source_name: Sutskever, I., Vinyals, O., Le, Q. (2014) NeurIPS 2014; WMT-14 results
events.card_summary_zh: Seq2Seq 用编码器和解码器把完整句子直接映射到另一种语言，机器翻译开始摆脱手工流水线。
events.card_summary_en: Seq2Seq used an encoder-decoder architecture to map complete sentences directly into another language, marking the beginning of machine translation's shift away from manual, rule-based pipelines.
events.summary_en: Ilya Sutskever, Oriol Vinyals, and Quoc Le published "Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks" at NeurIPS 2014. The Seq2Seq model utilized two Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks—an encoder and a decoder—to perform end-to-end machine translation. It achieved a BLEU score of 34.8 on the WMT-14 English-to-French translation task, outperforming the 33.3 baseline of traditional statistical machine translation (SMT). Key innovations included end-to-end training, encoding input sequences into fixed-length vectors, decoding these vectors into output sequences, and utilizing reversed input sequences alongside a four-layer LSTM and beam search.
events.context_en: Seq2Seq was developed during Sutskever's tenure at Google Brain, following his shift toward natural language processing after the success of AlexNet with Geoffrey Hinton's team in 2012. By extending end-to-end learning from image classification to sequence generation, Seq2Seq laid the groundwork for a lineage of breakthroughs: the introduction of attention mechanisms in 2015, the Transformer architecture in 2017, and subsequent foundation models like BERT and GPT-3. Sutskever later left Google in 2015 to co-found OpenAI as Chief Scientist, eventually departing in May 2024 to co-found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI). Following the Seq2Seq paper, Google launched Google Neural Machine Translation (GNMT) in 2016. This transitioned Google Translate from statistical machine translation to neural machine translation, yielding significant quality improvements and marking the first large-scale commercial application of the Seq2Seq model trajectory.
events.why_it_matters_en: Seq2Seq is the foundational breakthrough for the end-to-end sequence modeling paradigm. Many core concepts discussed in today's large language model ecosystem—such as encoder-decoder architectures, generative models, and unified approaches to translation, summarization, and dialogue—have their early roots in this 2014 research. Understanding the trajectory from Seq2Seq to Attention, and ultimately to the Transformer and BERT/GPT, clarifies why the 2017 Transformer was a critical turning point for NLP. It also illustrates how the divergent paths of BERT and GPT were both fundamentally built upon the combination of Seq2Seq and attention mechanisms.
events.source_author: I. Sutskever, O. Vinyals, Q. Le

events.title_zh: AlphaGo 胜樊麾:围棋 AI 首次击败职业棋手
events.title_en: AlphaGo Beats Fan Hui: Go AI Beats Professional for the First Time
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 10 月 9 日，DeepMind AlphaGo 在伦敦闭门比赛中以 5:0 击败欧洲围棋冠军樊麾二段，这是围棋 AI 首次击败职业棋手。
AlphaGo 用 CNN + MCTS（蒙特卡洛树搜索)+ RL（强化学习),训练分两阶段:(1）监督学习模仿人类专家走子，达到业余强手水平;(2）自我对弈强化学习，超过人类专家水平。
2016 年 1 月 27 日 Nature 529:484-489 论文正式发表,2016 年 3 月 AlphaGo 在首尔 4:1 击败李世石九段。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
AlphaGo 是 DeepMind 2014-2016 年的核心项目，由 David Silver 主导，Hassabis 2014 年收购后承诺 Google “5 年内解决围棋 AI”。
Silver 团队 2014-2015 年在 Google GPU 集群上训练 AlphaGo,分布式版本用 1202 个 CPU + 176 个 GPU。
AlphaGo 击败樊麾让 DeepMind 内部确认“围棋 AI 已成”,2016 年 3 月李世石比赛是 DeepMind 的全球公关活动，Google 投入 1000 万美元制作直播 + 媒体宣传。
AlphaGo 击败李世石后，DeepMind 2017 年 5 月在乌镇 AlphaGo 3:0 击败柯洁九段（当时世界第一),2017 年 10 月发布 AlphaGo Zero（无人类数据自我对弈),2018 年 12 月 AlphaZero 扩展到象棋、将棋,2019 年 11 月 MuZero 不需规则即可学习。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
AlphaGo 是“深度学习 + 强化学习”在复杂决策任务的工程巅峰。
它证明 DRL 不只能玩 Atari,还能战胜围棋（被视为“AI 圣杯”）。
理解 AlphaGo → AlphaGo Zero → AlphaZero → MuZero 这条线，可看出为什么 DeepMind 2016-2020 年在 DRL 路线上领先，以及为什么 OpenAI 2018-2019 年 Dota 2 OpenAI Five + 2020 年 GPT-3 RLHF 是把 DRL 路线扩展到语言模型的关键。
events.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2016) Nature 529:484-489; AlphaGo vs Fan Hui (2015-10)
events.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo 以五比零击败职业棋手樊麾，围棋这座长期被认为机器难以翻越的高墙第一次出现裂缝。
events.card_summary_en: Google DeepMind's AlphaGo defeated professional Go player Fan Hui 5-0, marking the first crack in a complex board game long considered an insurmountable wall for artificial intelligence.
events.summary_en: Google DeepMind's AlphaGo defeated European Go champion Fan Hui (2-dan) 5-0 in a closed-door match in London, becoming the first AI to beat a professional Go player. The system combined convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), and reinforcement learning (RL). Training occurred in two stages: supervised learning on human expert moves to reach a strong amateur level, followed by self-play reinforcement learning to surpass human experts. The research was formally published in Nature in January 2016, paving the way for AlphaGo's highly publicized 4-1 victory over Lee Sedol in March 2016.
events.context_en: AlphaGo was Google DeepMind's flagship project from 2014 to 2016. Led by David Silver, the initiative fulfilled Demis Hassabis's 2014 promise to Google upon acquisition that they would "solve Go AI within five years." Between 2014 and 2015, Silver's team trained AlphaGo on Google's GPU clusters, with the distributed version utilizing 1,202 CPUs and 176 GPUs. Defeating Fan Hui confirmed internally that Go AI had been achieved. The subsequent March 2016 match against Lee Sedol was a massive global public relations event, with Google investing $10 million in live broadcasting and media promotion. Following the Lee Sedol match, AlphaGo defeated then-world number one Ke Jie 3-0 in Wuzhen in May 2017. Google DeepMind continued to iterate rapidly, releasing AlphaGo Zero (trained entirely via self-play without human data) in October 2017, expanding to chess and shogi with AlphaZero in December 2018, and introducing MuZero—which learns without needing the rules of the game—in November 2019.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlphaGo represented an engineering pinnacle for applying deep learning and reinforcement learning to complex decision-making tasks. It proved that deep reinforcement learning (DRL) could not only master Atari games but also conquer Go, long considered the "holy grail" of AI research. The trajectory from AlphaGo to AlphaGo Zero, AlphaZero, and ultimately MuZero illustrates why Google DeepMind maintained a dominant lead in DRL from 2016 to 2020. Furthermore, this lineage highlights the foundational breakthroughs that later inspired OpenAI's Dota 2 agent (OpenAI Five) and the eventual application of RLHF to language models like GPT-3, successfully extending the DRL paradigm into natural language processing.

events.title_zh: He ResNet:超深网络训练突破
events.title_en: He ResNet: Ultra-Deep Network Training Breakthrough
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 12 月 10 日，Kaiming He、Xiangyu Zhang、Shaoqing Ren、Jian Sun 在 CVPR 2016 发表论文《Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition》。
ResNet 用“残差连接（Skip Connection)”让 152 层 CNN 可训练，在 ImageNet 上 top-5 错误率 3.57%,首次超过人类（5.1%）。
ResNet 关键创新:(1）残差块 y = F(x) + x,让梯度直接流过 Skip Connection;(2) 152 层 vs VGG 19 层，参数更少但精度更高;(3) BatchNorm + He 初始化让训练稳定。
ResNet 至今仍是视觉 + NLP + 语音 + RL 的标准组件。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
He 2015 年在 MSRA（微软亚洲研究院）工作，和 Zhang、Ren、Sun 团队尝试训练超深 CNN 但失败（梯度消失/爆炸）。
ResNet 灵感来自“如果浅层网络能学 f(x),那深层网络至少能学 identity(x)”,所以让网络学残差 F(x) = f(x) - x,而不是直接学 f(x）。
残差连接让梯度通过 Skip Connection 直接回传，解决 100+ 层网络的训练问题。
He 2016-2023 年在 MSRA + Facebook FAIR,2024 年加入 MIT EECS。
ResNet 残差连接后来被 Transformer(Vaswani 2017）继承，成为 Transformer 多层堆叠的关键技术。
ResNet 至今是 AI 史被引最多的论文之一（>20 万次）。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
ResNet 是“超深网络训练”的工程突破。
今天 LLM 圈讨论的“多层 Transformer”“残差连接”“深度 vs 宽度”,在 2015 年 ResNet 上都有早期版本。
理解 ResNet → Transformer → BERT → GPT-3 → GPT-4 这条线，可看出为什么 Transformer 能堆到 96 层（GPT-3 175B）、为什么残差连接是 LLM 训练稳定的基石，以及为什么“超深网络”在 2015 年 ResNet 之后成为 AI 主流。
events.card_summary_zh: 残差连接让上百层神经网络稳定训练，深度不再只是负担，而成为视觉模型继续扩展的通道。
events.card_summary_en: Residual connections enabled the stable training of neural networks with over a hundred layers. Depth was no longer a training burden, but a viable pathway for scaling vision models.
events.summary_en: Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, and Jian Sun published "Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition" (later presented at CVPR 2016). ResNet introduced skip connections to make a 152-layer Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trainable, achieving a 3.57% top-5 error rate on ImageNet—surpassing the human baseline (5.1%) for the first time. Key innovations included the residual block, which allowed gradients to flow directly through skip connections, and combining BatchNorm with He initialization for stability. Despite having 152 layers compared to VGG's 19, it required fewer parameters while delivering higher accuracy. ResNet remains a standard architectural component across vision, NLP, speech, and reinforcement learning.
events.context_en: In 2015, Kaiming He was working at Microsoft Research Asia (MSRA). His team, including Zhang, Ren, and Sun, initially struggled to train ultra-deep CNNs due to vanishing and exploding gradients. The inspiration for ResNet came from a simple premise: if a shallow network can learn a function, a deeper network should at least be able to learn an identity mapping. Therefore, they designed the network to learn the residual mapping, rather than the original function directly. This allowed gradients to propagate directly back through skip connections, solving the training bottleneck for networks with over 100 layers. He later worked at Facebook AI Research (FAIR) before joining MIT's EECS faculty in 2024. The residual connection introduced in ResNet was later adopted by the Transformer architecture in 2017, becoming a critical technique for stacking multiple attention layers. Today, the ResNet paper remains one of the most cited works in AI history, with over 200,000 citations.
events.why_it_matters_en: ResNet represents a foundational breakthrough in the engineering of ultra-deep neural networks. Many concepts discussed in today's large language model (LLM) landscape—such as multi-layer Transformers, residual connections, and the trade-offs between depth and width—have their early roots in the 2015 ResNet architecture. Tracing the model development path from ResNet to the Transformer, BERT, GPT-3, and GPT-4 reveals why modern models can scale to massive depths, such as GPT-3's 96 layers. Residual connections proved to be the cornerstone of stable LLM training, fundamentally shifting the AI trajectory toward ultra-deep networks as the dominant paradigm.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 成立:非营利 AI 研究实验室启动
events.title_en: OpenAI Founded: Nonprofit AI Research Lab Launched
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 12 月 11 日，OpenAI 在旧金山成立，由 Sam Altman、Elon Musk、Greg Brockman、Ilya Sutskever、Wojciech Zaremba、John Schulman 联合创办。
初始承诺 10 亿美元资金，实际到位约 1.3 亿美元。
OpenAI 宣称目标“构建安全有益的通用人工智能（AGI),为全人类而非单一公司服务”,以非营利形式运营。
2019 年 OpenAI 转型为“有限利润（capped-profit)”公司 OpenAI LP,Microsoft 2019-2023 年累计投资 130 亿美元，OpenAI 从非营利实验室变成 Microsoft 旗下 AI 子公司。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
OpenAI 成立的直接导火索是 2014 年 Google 收购 DeepMind。
Musk 2014 年多次公开担心 Google 通过 DeepMind 垄断 AI,2015 年和 Altman、Brockman 商量“建立非营利 AI 实验室对抗 Google”。
Musk 2015-2018 年担任 OpenAI 董事,2018 年因和 Altman 路线分歧（OpenAI 是否商业化）离开董事会。
OpenAI 2015-2019 年深耕 DRL + 游戏 AI(Dota 2 OpenAI Five 2018),2019 年 GPT-2 论文让 OpenAI 进入 LLM 路线,2020 年 GPT-3 + Microsoft 独家许可让 OpenAI 商业化加速,2022 年 ChatGPT 让 OpenAI 成为 AI 圈最知名公司。
Musk 2023 年离开 OpenAI 后创办 xAI(Grok LLM),2024 年起诉 OpenAI 违反非营利承诺。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
OpenAI 是 LLM 时代的核心玩家。
今天 ChatGPT、GPT-4、DALL-E、Whisper、Sora 都来自 OpenAI。
理解 OpenAI 2015 成立 → 2019 OpenAI LP → 2020 GPT-3 → 2022 ChatGPT → 2023 GPT-4 → 2024 o1 这条线，可看出为什么 OpenAI 从“非营利研究实验室”变成“Microsoft 旗下 AI 子公司”,以及为什么 2023-2024 年 OpenAI 内部（Altman 解雇事件、Musk 起诉）持续动荡。
events.source_name: OpenAI founding announcement (2015-12-11); OpenAI LP structure (2019-03)
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 以“让通用人工智能造福全人类”为目标成立，后来成为大模型时代最具影响力的实验室之一。
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI was founded with the mission of ensuring artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity, eventually becoming one of the most influential research labs in the foundation model era.
events.summary_en: OpenAI was founded in San Francisco by Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Greg Brockman, Ilya Sutskever, Wojciech Zaremba, and John Schulman. Initially operating as a nonprofit, the lab launched with $1 billion in pledged funding, though only about $130 million materialized. Its stated mission was to build safe, beneficial artificial general intelligence (AGI) that serves humanity rather than a single corporation. In 2019, OpenAI transitioned to a "capped-profit" structure (OpenAI LP). Following a cumulative $13 billion investment from Microsoft between 2019 and 2023, the organization effectively shifted from an independent nonprofit lab to a closely aligned Microsoft AI subsidiary.
events.context_en: The direct catalyst for OpenAI's founding was Google's 2014 acquisition of DeepMind. Elon Musk had publicly expressed concerns that Google might monopolize AI, leading him to discuss forming a nonprofit lab to counter Google with Sam Altman and Greg Brockman in 2015. Musk served on OpenAI's board until 2018, when he departed following disagreements with Altman over the organization's trajectory and potential commercialization. Between 2015 and 2019, OpenAI focused heavily on deep reinforcement learning and game AI, notably developing the Dota 2 bot OpenAI Five. The 2019 GPT-2 paper pivoted the lab toward the large language model trajectory. By 2020, the release of GPT-3 and an exclusive licensing deal with Microsoft accelerated its commercialization, culminating in the 2022 launch of ChatGPT, which made OpenAI the most prominent company in the AI sector. Musk later founded xAI in 2023 and sued OpenAI in 2024, alleging the company had breached its original nonprofit commitments.
events.why_it_matters_en: OpenAI is a central player in the large language model era, responsible for foundational products like ChatGPT, GPT-4, DALL-E, Whisper, and Sora. Tracing the organization's trajectory—from its 2015 nonprofit founding to the 2019 creation of OpenAI LP, the 2020 release of GPT-3, and the subsequent launches of ChatGPT, GPT-4, and the o1 reasoning model—illustrates its profound transformation. This evolution from an independent research lab to a heavily commercialized entity backed by Microsoft provides essential context for understanding the company's ongoing internal turbulence, including the brief 2023 ousting of Sam Altman and subsequent legal challenges from Elon Musk.

events.title_zh: AlphaGo 4:1 胜李世石:围棋 AI 越过职业九段
events.title_en: AlphaGo 4:1 Beats Lee Sedol: Go AI Crosses Pro 9-Dan
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 3 月 9-15 日，DeepMind AlphaGo 在首尔四季酒店 5 局比赛中以 4:1 击败韩国职业九段李世石（Lee Sedol),李世石在第 4 局（3 月 13 日）唯一胜局被称为“神之一手”(Move 78）。
AlphaGo 用 MCTS + 深度策略网络 + 深度价值网络,176 个 GPU + 1202 个 CPU,每步搜索 0.2 秒。
Nature 2016 年 1 月 28 日论文《Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search》预演结果,3 月正式对弈震惊全球。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
AlphaGo 项目 2014 年由 Demis Hassabis、David Silver 主导，Aja Huang（黄士杰）是主要工程师。
Hassabis 2014 年承诺 5 年内击败职业棋手，实际只用 18 个月。
AlphaGo 在 2015-10 已经击败欧洲冠军樊麾 5:0（保密到 2016-01 Nature 论文发表）。
李世石赛后宣布“再不与 AI 下棋”,2019 年 11 月 27 日正式退役，理由是“AI 是不可战胜的实体”。
韩国围棋协会 2016-04 给 AlphaGo 颁发名誉九段证书。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
AlphaGo 4:1 胜李世石是 AI 史最大公关事件。
它让“深度学习可以解决直觉问题”这一论点被全球公众理解，直接推动 2016 年之后 AI 投资爆发。
理解 AlphaGo 李世石（2016) → AlphaGo Zero(2017) → AlphaZero(2017) → MuZero(2019) → AlphaFold2(2020）这条线，可看出 DeepMind 路线：围棋是 RL + Search 的练兵场，真正目标是科学与工业问题。
events.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2016) Nature 529:484-489; AlphaGo vs Lee Sedol match record
events.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo 战胜李世石把 AI 推到全球公众面前，其中第 37 手也让人第一次感到机器可能产生陌生的创造力。
events.card_summary_en: AlphaGo's victory over Lee Sedol thrust AI into the global public spotlight. Its famous Move 37 also gave observers their first glimpse of what appeared to be an alien, machine-driven creativity.
events.summary_en: Between March 9 and 15, DeepMind's AlphaGo defeated South Korean professional 9-dan Go player Lee Sedol 4-1 in a five-game match at the Four Seasons Hotel in Seoul. Lee's sole victory in Game 4 featured his famous "God's Touch" (Move 78). AlphaGo utilized Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) combined with deep policy and value networks, running on 1,202 CPUs and 176 GPUs to compute moves in 0.2 seconds. While a January 2016 Nature paper had previewed the system's capabilities, the March match shocked the world by demonstrating AI's mastery of the complex board game.
events.context_en: Initiated in 2014, the AlphaGo project was led by Demis Hassabis and David Silver, with Aja Huang serving as the lead engineer. Although Hassabis initially projected it would take five years to defeat a professional Go player, the team achieved this milestone in just 18 months. Before facing Lee Sedol, AlphaGo had already defeated European champion Fan Hui 5-0 in October 2015, a result kept secret until the Nature paper's publication in January 2016. The psychological impact of the 2016 match was profound. Following the event, Lee Sedol declared he would no longer play against AI, eventually retiring from professional Go in November 2019 after concluding that AI was an "invincible entity." In recognition of the system's unprecedented skill level, the Korea Baduk Association awarded AlphaGo an honorary 9-dan certificate in April 2016.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlphaGo's victory over Lee Sedol stands as one of the most significant public awareness events in AI history. It demonstrated to a global audience that deep learning could solve problems previously thought to require human intuition, directly catalyzing a massive surge in AI investment after 2016. Furthermore, the match established a clear trajectory for DeepMind's research. The progression from AlphaGo to AlphaGo Zero (2017), AlphaZero (2017), MuZero (2019), and ultimately AlphaFold 2 (2020) reveals that Go was merely a testing ground for reinforcement learning and search algorithms. The ultimate objective was always to apply these foundational breakthroughs to complex scientific and industrial challenges.

events.title_zh: Google TPU v1:AI 专用芯片公开
events.title_en: Google TPU v1: AI-Specific Chip Public
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 5 月 18 日，Google 在 Google I/O 2016 主题演讲公开 TPU(Tensor Processing Unit）。
TPU v1 是 Google 2013 年内部立项、2015 年数据中心部署的 ASIC,专为矩阵乘法优化,8-bit 整数 Systolic Array 架构,28nm 工艺,700MHz,92 TOPS,28W TDP。
TPU 在 AlphaGo 与李世石对弈（2016-03）中担任推理硬件，在 RankBrain 搜索排序中已运行 3 年。
2017 年 4 月 Norman Jouppi 等在 ISCA 2017 发表论文《In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit》。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
TPU 项目 2013 年由 Google 工程师 Jeff Dean 推动，目标是为 RankBrain 推理降本。
原计划用 FPGA,但 FPGA 时钟频率低、推理延迟高。
Google 硬件团队 2014 年转 ASIC 路线,2015 年第一批 TPU 部署到数据中心。
TPU v1 只做推理,2017 年 TPU v2(180 TFLOPS FP16）开始训练,2018 年 TPU v3(420 TFLOPS）液冷,2021 年 TPU v4 Pod 4096 芯片。
TPU 让 Google 内部训练 BERT、PaLM、Gemini 不依赖 NVIDIA GPU。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
TPU v1 是大厂自研 AI 芯片的起点。
它直接推动 NVIDIA 2017 年推出 Tensor Core(V100）、Apple 2017 年 A11 Neural Engine、华为 2018 年昇腾 910、Tesla 2019 年 FSD 芯片。
理解 TPU → Volta Tensor Core → A11 Neural Engine 这条硬件线，可看出 2016 年之后 AI 训练成本每年下降 50% 的硬件基础。
events.source_name: Jouppi et al. (2017) ISCA; Google I/O 2016 keynote
events.card_summary_zh: Google TPU v1：AI 专用芯片公开；TPU v1 是大厂自研 AI 芯片的起点。
events.card_summary_en: Google publicly unveiled the Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) v1, a custom ASIC optimized for AI inference. This marked the beginning of major tech companies developing their own in-house AI silicon.
events.summary_en: Google publicly introduced the Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) at the Google I/O 2016 keynote. Initiated internally in 2013 and deployed in data centers by 2015, TPU v1 was a custom ASIC optimized specifically for matrix multiplication. It featured an 8-bit integer systolic array architecture built on a 28nm process, delivering 92 TOPS at 700MHz with a 28W TDP. The hardware powered inference for AlphaGo during its historic March 2016 match against Lee Sedol and had already been running Google's RankBrain search algorithm. Norman Jouppi and colleagues later detailed its architecture in a 2017 ISCA paper.
events.context_en: Driven by Google engineer Jeff Dean in 2013, the TPU project was initially conceived to reduce inference costs for the RankBrain search algorithm. The team originally considered using FPGAs but found them lacking due to low clock frequencies and high inference latency. Consequently, Google's hardware team pivoted to an Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) design in 2014, successfully deploying the first batch of TPUs to their data centers in 2015. While TPU v1 was strictly designed for inference workloads, Google rapidly iterated on the architecture. The company introduced TPU v2 in 2017, which added training capabilities and delivered 180 TFLOPS (FP16). This was followed by the liquid-cooled TPU v3 (420 TFLOPS) in 2018 and the massive TPU v4 Pods featuring 4,096 chips in 2021. This sustained hardware trajectory allowed Google to train foundational models like BERT, PaLM, and Gemini internally, significantly reducing its reliance on NVIDIA GPUs for large-scale AI compute.
events.why_it_matters_en: TPU v1 marked the starting point for major technology companies developing their own custom AI silicon. Its introduction catalyzed a broader industry shift toward specialized AI hardware, directly influencing NVIDIA's release of the Tensor Core with the V100 architecture in 2017, Apple's A11 Neural Engine the same year, Huawei's Ascend 910 in 2018, and Tesla's FSD chip in 2019. Tracing this hardware trajectory—from the TPU to Volta Tensor Cores and mobile neural engines—reveals the foundational infrastructure that enabled AI compute costs to drop significantly in the years following 2016.

events.title_zh: DeepMind WaveNet:神经网络生成原始音频波形
events.title_en: DeepMind WaveNet: Neural Network Generates Raw Audio Waveform
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 9 月 8 日，DeepMind 在 arXiv:1609.03499 发表《WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio》。
WaveNet 用 Causal Dilated Convolution（因果膨胀卷积，膨胀系数 1,2,4,...,512),把音频波形作为时间序列自回归预测下一采样点。
WaveNet 在 TTS（文本转语音）上达到人类级 MOS 评分（4.21 vs 人类 4.55),在钢琴、语音生成上接近真实。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
WaveNet 一作 Aaron van den Oord,DeepMind 团队。
WaveNet 论文 2016-09 发表,2017 年 Google 翻译 TTS、Google Assistant 语音用 WaveNet。
WaveNet 推理慢（1 秒音频 1 分钟 CPU),2017-10 Parallel WaveNet 学生-老师蒸馏加速 1000 倍。
WaveNet 路线 2022 年被 diffusion 路线（AudioLDM）和 VALL-E(2023）取代，但 Causal Dilated Conv 思想影响 WaveGAN、Jukebox。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
WaveNet 是「自回归生成」范式在音频领域的奠基。
理解 WaveNet(2016,音频) → PixelCNN(2016,图像) → GPT(2018,文本) → DALL-E(2021,文本到图像) → Sora(2024,文本到视频）这条线，可看出 2016-2024 年生成式 AI 跨模态演化：同一「自回归 + 概率分布」范式跨音频/图像/文本/视频。
events.source_name: van den Oord, A. et al. (2016) arXiv:1609.03499
events.card_summary_zh: WaveNet 直接逐点生成声音波形，机器语音从拼接录音迈向更自然的神经生成时代。
events.card_summary_en: WaveNet directly generated audio waveforms sample by sample, shifting machine speech from concatenative recording techniques to a more natural era of neural generation.
events.summary_en: In September 2016, DeepMind published "WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio" on arXiv. The model utilized causal dilated convolutions—with dilation factors scaling exponentially from 1 to 512—to treat audio waveforms as time series, autoregressively predicting the next sample point. In text-to-speech (TTS) applications, WaveNet achieved near-human Mean Opinion Scores (MOS), scoring 4.21 compared to the human baseline of 4.55, and produced highly realistic piano and speech generation.
events.context_en: Led by first author Aaron van den Oord and the DeepMind team, the WaveNet paper was published in September 2016. By 2017, Google had integrated WaveNet into Google Translate's text-to-speech system and Google Assistant to provide more natural-sounding voices. However, the original model suffered from extremely slow inference speeds, requiring one minute of CPU time to generate just one second of audio. To resolve this, DeepMind introduced Parallel WaveNet in October 2017, utilizing a student-teacher knowledge distillation approach that accelerated generation by a factor of 1,000. While the WaveNet architecture was largely superseded by diffusion-based models like AudioLDM in 2022 and VALL-E in 2023, its core concept of causal dilated convolutions profoundly influenced subsequent audio generation models, including WaveGAN and OpenAI's Jukebox.
events.why_it_matters_en: WaveNet established the foundational breakthrough of applying the autoregressive generation paradigm to the audio domain. Tracing the lineage from WaveNet (audio, 2016) and PixelCNN (images, 2016) to GPT (text, 2018), DALL-E (text-to-image, 2021), and Sora (text-to-video, 2024) reveals the cross-modal evolution of generative AI over nearly a decade. It demonstrated that a unified approach—combining autoregressive modeling with probability distributions—could be successfully adapted across audio, image, text, and video formats, paving the way for modern multimodal AI systems.
events.source_author: van den Oord, A. et al. (institutional record)

events.title_zh: PyTorch 开源:动态图框架进入主流
events.title_en: PyTorch Open-Sourced: Dynamic Graph Framework Goes Mainstream
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 1 月 18 日，Facebook AI Research(FAIR）发布 PyTorch 0.1,Adam Paszke、Sam Gross、Soumith Chintala 主导开发。
PyTorch 基于 Torch7,核心创新是动态计算图（Define-by-Run),比 TensorFlow 1.x 静态图更易调试，Python 原生语法接近 NumPy。
2017 年 8 月 PyTorch 0.2 分布式训练,2018 年 4 月 0.4 合并 Variable 与 Tensor,2018 年 12 月 1.0 稳定版。
2019 年 PyTorch 在顶级会议论文使用率超过 TensorFlow,2020 年 HuggingFace 全面转向 PyTorch。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
PyTorch 项目 2016 年由 FAIR 总监 Yann LeCun 推动，目标是替代 Lua Torch(2011 年 Ronan Collobert 开发）。
Paszke 团队 2016 年 8 月开始重写,12 月内部 demo,2017 年 1 月公开发布。
PyTorch 在 2017-2018 年迅速被学术界接受，NeurIPS 2018 论文 PyTorch 占比 30%,2019 年 50%,2020 年 70% 以上。
Google 2019 年推出 TensorFlow 2.0 抄 PyTorch 动态图（Keras API),但学术界已不可逆转向 PyTorch。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
PyTorch 决定了 2017 年之后 AI 研究的工具栈。
理解 PyTorch 开源（2017) → HuggingFace Transformers(2018) → PyTorch Lightning(2019) → PyTorch 2.0(2022）这条线，可看出为什么 2020 年代 LLM 时代几乎所有开源模型（LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen、DeepSeek）都默认 PyTorch。
events.source_name: Paszke, A. et al. (2017) PyTorch 0.1 release; NeurIPS 2019 autodiff workshop
events.card_summary_zh: PyTorch 让研究者像写普通 Python 一样构建和调试神经网络，迅速成为 AI 研究最重要的工具之一。
events.card_summary_en: PyTorch allowed researchers to build and debug neural networks as easily as writing standard Python code, rapidly becoming one of the most essential tools in AI research.
events.summary_en: On January 18, 2017, Facebook AI Research (FAIR) released PyTorch 0.1, led by developers Adam Paszke, Sam Gross, and Soumith Chintala. Built on Torch7, its core innovation was the dynamic computational graph (define-by-run). This approach made debugging significantly easier than TensorFlow 1.x's static graphs, offering native Python syntax closely resembling NumPy. Subsequent updates introduced distributed training in version 0.2 (August 2017), merged Variable and Tensor in 0.4 (April 2018), and culminated in the stable 1.0 release in December 2018. By 2019, PyTorch surpassed TensorFlow in usage at top-tier academic conferences, and in 2020, Hugging Face fully transitioned to the framework.
events.context_en: The PyTorch project was initiated in 2016 by FAIR Director Yann LeCun with the goal of replacing Lua Torch, which had been developed by Ronan Collobert in 2011. Adam Paszke's team began rewriting the framework in August 2016, producing an internal demo by December before the public release in January 2017. PyTorch was rapidly adopted by the academic community between 2017 and 2018. Its usage in NeurIPS papers grew from 30% in 2018 to 50% in 2019, eventually exceeding 70% by 2020. Although Google responded in 2019 by releasing TensorFlow 2.0, which adopted dynamic graphs and eager execution via the Keras API to mirror PyTorch's functionality, the academic community had already made an irreversible shift toward PyTorch.
events.why_it_matters_en: PyTorch fundamentally defined the AI research tool stack from 2017 onward. Tracing its development trajectory—from the initial open-source release in 2017 to Hugging Face Transformers in 2018, PyTorch Lightning in 2019, and PyTorch 2.0 in 2022—illustrates its foundational role in the ecosystem. This lineage explains why nearly all open-weight large language models in the 2020s, including LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen, and DeepSeek, default to PyTorch as their primary framework.

events.title_zh: Transformer 论文:Attention Is All You Need
events.title_en: Transformer Paper: Attention Is All You Need
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 6 月 12 日，Ashish Vaswani 等 8 位 Google Brain/Google Research 研究员在 NeurIPS 2017 发表《Attention Is All You Need》（arXiv:1706.03762）。
Transformer 抛弃 RNN/CNN,只用 Self-Attention(Q/K/V 点积注意力) + Positional Encoding + Feed-Forward 层 + 残差连接 + LayerNorm。
原论文在 WMT 2014 英德/英法翻译上达到 SOTA,训练成本是当时最好的 RNN 模型的 1/10。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
Transformer 论文作者 8 人:Ashish Vaswani、Noam Shazeer、Niki Parmar、Jakob Uszkoreit、Llion Jones、Aidan N. Gomez、Łukasz Kaiser、Illia Polosukhin（论文声明 8 人为同等贡献、署名顺序随机）。
核心创意来自 Shazeer 和 Kaiser 的“注意力可以替代 RNN”讨论。
论文原计划投 ICML 2017 被拒，改投 NeurIPS 2017 接收。
论文发表后 1 年内，BERT(2018）、GPT(2018）、T5(2019）、ViT(2020）都基于 Transformer。
Transformer 7 位作者 2021 年后陆续离开 Google,创立 Adept、Character.AI、Essential AI、Sakana AI 等公司。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
Transformer 是 2017 年之后所有 LLM 的基础架构。
理解 Transformer(2017) → GPT(2018,decoder-only) → BERT(2018,encoder-only) → GPT-3(2020,scaling) → ChatGPT(2022,RLHF) → GPT-4(2023,多模态) → Gemini/Claude/Llama(2024-2025）这条线，可看出 2017 年之后 AI 史 = Transformer 扩展史。
events.source_name: Vaswani, A. et al. (2017) NeurIPS; arXiv:1706.03762
events.card_summary_zh: Transformer 用注意力机制取代循环结构，让模型更容易并行扩展，并成为后来大语言模型的共同底座。
events.card_summary_en: The Transformer architecture replaced recurrent structures with attention mechanisms, enabling highly parallelizable model scaling and establishing the common foundation for all subsequent large language models.
events.summary_en: Ashish Vaswani and seven other researchers from Google Brain and Google Research published 'Attention Is All You Need' (arXiv:1706.03762), later presented at NeurIPS 2017. The paper introduced the Transformer, an architecture that discarded recurrent and convolutional neural networks entirely. Instead, it relied solely on self-attention mechanisms (query/key/value dot-product attention), positional encoding, feed-forward layers, residual connections, and layer normalization. The original model achieved state-of-the-art results on the WMT 2014 English-to-German and English-to-French translation tasks, requiring only a tenth of the training cost of the best contemporary RNN models.
events.context_en: The paper was co-authored by eight researchers: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Łukasz Kaiser, and Illia Polosukhin. The authors explicitly stated that all eight contributed equally, with the author order determined randomly. The core concept emerged from discussions between Shazeer and Kaiser regarding whether attention mechanisms could entirely replace RNNs. The paper was initially rejected by ICML 2017 before being accepted by NeurIPS. Within a few years of its publication, the Transformer became the basis for a wave of influential models, including BERT (2018), GPT (2018), T5 (2019), and Vision Transformer (ViT, 2020). After 2021, seven of the eight original authors eventually left Google to found prominent AI startups, including Adept, Character.AI, Essential AI, and Sakana AI, significantly shaping the broader AI industry landscape.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Transformer represents a foundational breakthrough that serves as the underlying architecture for virtually all modern large language models. Tracing the model development path from the original Transformer (2017) to decoder-only GPT (2018), encoder-only BERT (2018), scaled-up GPT-3 (2020), RLHF-tuned ChatGPT (2022), multimodal GPT-4 (2023), and the Gemini, Claude, and Llama families (2024–2025) reveals a clear trajectory. Ultimately, the history of generative AI since 2017 is largely the history of scaling and refining the Transformer architecture.

events.title_zh: AlphaGo Zero:从零自学击败旧版 AlphaGo
events.title_en: AlphaGo Zero: Self-Play Beats Old AlphaGo from Scratch
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 10 月 18 日，DeepMind 在 Nature 550:354-359 发表《Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge》。
AlphaGo Zero 完全不用人类棋谱，只用自我对弈 + RL,从随机落子开始 3 天击败 2016 年胜李世石的 AlphaGo Lee,21 天击败 2017 年 60 连胜 Master 版本,40 天训练达到超越所有人类围棋 AI 的水平。
AlphaGo Zero 用单一残差网络同时输出策略和价值，简化了原 AlphaGo 双网络结构。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
AlphaGo Zero 论文一作 David Silver。
Silver 在 Nature 论文中强调“AI can learn from itself without human data”。
AlphaGo Zero 训练只用 4 个 TPU v2,远少于 AlphaGo Lee 的 176 GPU + 1202 CPU。
同年 12 月 5 日 DeepMind 发表 AlphaZero(arXiv:1712.01815),把同一算法扩展到国际象棋、将棋,4 小时击败 Stockfish,2 小时击败 Elmo。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
AlphaGo Zero 是“self-play + RL”范式的起点。
它证明 AI 不需要人类数据就能在复杂任务上达到超人水平，直接催生 2019 年 MuZero（不依赖规则）和 2024 年 AlphaProof。
理解 AlphaGo Lee(2016,有监督) → AlphaGo Zero(2017,纯 RL) → AlphaZero(2017,通用棋类) → MuZero(2019,不依赖规则）这条线，可看出 DeepMind 路线：剥离人类知识是走向通用智能的必经之路。
events.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2017) Nature 550:354-359; AlphaZero arXiv:1712.01815
events.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo Zero 不再学习人类棋谱，只靠自我对弈超越旧版系统，机器第一次展示出摆脱人类经验上限的路径。
events.card_summary_en: By discarding human game records and relying entirely on self-play, AlphaGo Zero surpassed previous versions, demonstrating a path for machines to transcend the limits of human experience.
events.summary_en: DeepMind published "Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge" in Nature. Discarding human game records entirely, AlphaGo Zero relied solely on self-play and reinforcement learning. Starting from random moves, it defeated the AlphaGo Lee version (which beat Lee Sedol in 2016) in just three days. Within 21 days, it defeated the "Master" version that had achieved a 60-game winning streak in 2017, and after 40 days of training, it surpassed all previous Go AIs. Architecturally, AlphaGo Zero simplified the original dual-network structure by using a single residual network to output both policy and value.
events.context_en: David Silver served as the lead author of the AlphaGo Zero paper, explicitly emphasizing in the Nature publication that artificial intelligence could learn from itself without relying on human data. This breakthrough was accompanied by significant hardware efficiency gains: AlphaGo Zero required only four TPU v2 chips for training, a massive reduction compared to the 176 GPUs and 1,202 CPUs utilized by the earlier AlphaGo Lee system. Building on this momentum, DeepMind published the AlphaZero paper (arXiv:1712.01815) on December 5 of the same year. This subsequent work generalized the self-play algorithm beyond Go, applying it to chess and shogi. In remarkable demonstrations of its adaptability, AlphaZero defeated the world-champion chess engine Stockfish in just four hours of training and the top shogi engine Elmo in two hours, solidifying the power of this generalized reinforcement learning approach.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlphaGo Zero marked the starting point of the self-play and reinforcement learning paradigm. It proved that AI could achieve superhuman performance on complex tasks without requiring human data, directly paving the way for subsequent breakthroughs like MuZero in 2019 (which learned without being given game rules) and AlphaProof in 2024. The trajectory from AlphaGo Lee (supervised learning) to AlphaGo Zero (pure RL), AlphaZero (generalized board games), and MuZero (rule-independent) illustrates a core philosophy in DeepMind's model development path: stripping away reliance on human knowledge is a necessary step toward achieving artificial general intelligence.

events.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-1:预训练 + 微调范式确立
events.title_en: OpenAI GPT-1: Pre-training + Fine-tuning Paradigm Established
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 6 月 11 日，OpenAI 在论文《Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training》发布 GPT-1。
GPT-1 用 12 层 Transformer Decoder(768 维隐藏层,12 头,117M 参数),在 BookCorpus(7000+ 本未出版小说）上无监督预训练，然后在 12 个 NLP 任务上微调。
GPT-1 在 9/12 任务上达到 SOTA,证明“无监督预训练 + 有监督微调”范式可行。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
GPT-1 一作 Alec Radford,论文未投会议，直接在 OpenAI 网站发布。
GPT-1 灵感来自 Howard-Ruder 2018 ULMFiT、2017 Transformer、2018-02 ELMo 等前作（注:GPT-1 发布于 2018-06,早于 BERT 2018-10,不可能“灵感来自 BERT”）。
Radford 团队选择 Decoder-only 路线，与 Google BERT(Encoder-only）形成对照。
GPT-1 117M 参数远小于 BERT-Large 340M,但 Radford 在 2019-02 GPT-2 把参数扩到 1.5B,在 2020-05 GPT-3 扩到 175B,验证“Decoder-only + Scaling”路线。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
GPT-1 是 GPT 路线的起点，奠定 OpenAI 后续 6 年技术栈。
理解 GPT-1(2018,117M) → GPT-2(2019,1.5B) → GPT-3(2020,175B) → InstructGPT(2022,RLHF) → ChatGPT(2022) → GPT-4(2023）这条线，可看出 OpenAI 路线:Decoder-only + Scaling Laws 是 LLM 时代的核心赌注。
events.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2018) OpenAI blog; GPT-1 paper
events.card_summary_zh: GPT-1 证明同一个预训练语言模型可以适配多种任务，后来大模型“先通学、再专用”的路线由此起步。
events.card_summary_en: GPT-1 demonstrated that a single pre-trained language model could be adapted to multiple tasks, initiating the foundational pre-training and fine-tuning trajectory for large language models.
events.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-1 in the paper "Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training." The model utilized a 12-layer Transformer decoder architecture with 117 million parameters, 12 attention heads, and a 768-dimensional hidden state. It underwent unsupervised pre-training on the BookCorpus dataset—comprising over 7,000 unpublished novels—before being fine-tuned on 12 distinct natural language processing tasks. By achieving state-of-the-art results on 9 of these 12 tasks, GPT-1 successfully validated the viability of the unsupervised pre-training combined with supervised fine-tuning paradigm.
events.context_en: Lead author Alec Radford published the GPT-1 paper directly on the OpenAI website rather than submitting it to an academic conference. The architecture drew inspiration from preceding work, including the original 2017 Transformer, ELMo (February 2018), and ULMFiT (2018). Notably, GPT-1 predated Google's BERT by several months. Radford's team opted for a decoder-only architecture, contrasting with the encoder-only approach later popularized by BERT. While GPT-1's 117 million parameters were significantly fewer than BERT-Large's 340 million, this initial model laid the groundwork for OpenAI's subsequent scaling efforts. Radford and his team would later expand this architecture to 1.5 billion parameters with GPT-2 in 2019 and 175 billion parameters with GPT-3 in 2020, ultimately validating the "decoder-only plus scaling" model development path.
events.why_it_matters_en: GPT-1 marks the starting point of the Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) series, establishing the foundational technology stack that OpenAI would build upon for the next six years. Tracing the lineage from GPT-1 (117M parameters in 2018) through GPT-2 (1.5B in 2019), GPT-3 (175B in 2020), InstructGPT (RLHF in 2022), ChatGPT (2022), and GPT-4 (2023) reveals OpenAI's core strategic bet for the large language model era: combining decoder-only architectures with scaling laws. This foundational breakthrough proved that a unified architecture could be generalized across diverse tasks.

events.title_zh: Google BERT:双向预训练 NLP 范式确立
events.title_en: Google BERT: Bidirectional Pre-training NLP Paradigm Established
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 10 月 11 日，Google AI 在 arXiv:1810.04805 发表《BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding》。
BERT 用 24 层 Transformer Encoder(340M 参数),在 BookCorpus + English Wikipedia(3.3B 词）上用 Masked Language Model(MLM) + Next Sentence Prediction(NSP）预训练。
BERT 在 11 个 NLP 任务上刷新 SOTA,包括 GLUE(7.7% 提升）、SQuAD v1.1(1.5% F1）、SQuAD v2.0(4.6% F1）。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
BERT 一作 Jacob Devlin,Google AI Language 团队。
Devlin 2018-10 论文与 OpenAI GPT-1(2018-06）形成对照:GPT 用 Decoder-only（自回归),BERT 用 Encoder-only（双向 MLM）。
BERT 论文 24 小时内被引用 100+ 次,2019-10-25 Google Search 上线 BERT,影响约 10% 英文搜索 query。
2019 年 RoBERTa(Facebook）、ALBERT(Google）、DistilBERT(HuggingFace）、ELECTRA(Stanford）都基于 BERT。
BERT 路线 2020 年后逐渐被 GPT 路线（Decoder-only + Scaling）取代。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
BERT 是 2018-2020 年 NLP 标准范式。
理解 BERT(2018) → RoBERTa(2019) → T5(2019,encoder-decoder) → GPT-3(2020,decoder-only) → ChatGPT(2022,decoder-only + RLHF）这条线，可看出 NLP 范式演化:2018 BERT 主流 → 2020 GPT-3 反超 → 2022 ChatGPT 全面胜出。
BERT 在工业 NLU（搜索、推荐、客服）至今仍有大量部署。
events.source_name: Devlin, J. et al. (2018) arXiv:1810.04805; NAACL 2019
events.card_summary_zh: BERT 同时读取词语左右两侧的上下文，一举刷新多项语言任务，并迅速成为 NLP 的标准底座。
events.card_summary_en: By processing context from both the left and right sides of a word simultaneously, BERT set new records across multiple language tasks and quickly became the foundational standard for natural language processing.
events.summary_en: Google AI published "BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding." The model utilized a 24-layer Transformer encoder with 340 million parameters, pre-trained on BookCorpus and the English Wikipedia (totaling 3.3 billion words) using Masked Language Modeling (MLM) and Next Sentence Prediction (NSP) objectives. BERT established new state-of-the-art results across 11 natural language processing tasks, including a 7.7% improvement on the GLUE benchmark and significant F1 score gains on both SQuAD v1.1 and SQuAD v2.0.
events.context_en: Led by Jacob Devlin at the Google AI Language team, BERT presented a direct architectural contrast to OpenAI's GPT-1, which had been released earlier that year. While GPT-1 relied on a decoder-only, autoregressive architecture, BERT utilized an encoder-only design with bidirectional masked language modeling. The paper garnered immense attention, receiving over 100 citations within 24 hours of publication. By October 2019, Google integrated BERT into its core search engine, impacting approximately 10% of English search queries. The architecture sparked a wave of derivative models throughout 2019, including Meta's RoBERTa, Google's ALBERT, Hugging Face's DistilBERT, and Stanford's ELECTRA. Although the BERT trajectory dominated early transformer research, it was gradually eclipsed after 2020 by the decoder-only scaling approach championed by the GPT series.
events.why_it_matters_en: BERT defined the standard paradigm for natural language processing between 2018 and 2020. The trajectory from BERT to models like T5, GPT-3, and eventually ChatGPT illustrates a critical architectural evolution in AI: from the early dominance of encoder-only bidirectional models to the eventual triumph of scaled, decoder-only autoregressive systems. Despite being superseded in generative tasks, BERT's highly efficient architecture remains heavily deployed today in industrial natural language understanding applications, powering search engines, recommendation systems, and automated customer service platforms.

events.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-2:大规模生成预训练首次披露
events.title_en: OpenAI GPT-2: Large-Scale Generative Pre-training Disclosed
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 2 月 14 日，OpenAI 在博客《Better Language Models and Their Implications》发布 GPT-2 论文《Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners》（Radford 等）。
GPT-2 用 48 层 Transformer Decoder,1.5B 参数，在 WebText(4500 万网页,40GB）上训练。
GPT-2 在零样本（zero-shot）下完成翻译、问答、摘要、写作等 7 个任务。
OpenAI 以“恶意使用风险”为由，分阶段发布:2019-02-14 发布 117M 小模型,2019-05 发布 345M,2019-08 发布 774M,2019-11-05 发布完整 1.5B 模型。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
GPT-2 一作 Alec Radford,OpenAI 团队。
GPT-2 论文未投会议，直接 OpenAI 网站发布。
GPT-2 分阶段发布是 OpenAI 第一次“AI 安全影响产品决策”,引发社区激烈争论:AllenAI、HuggingFace 等批评 OpenAI“营销噱头”,DeepMind、Anthropic 等支持“谨慎发布”。
2019-09 OpenAI 内部反转,11 月发布完整模型,2020 年 GPT-3 论文不再分阶段。
GPT-2 引发 2019 年“Deepfake + 文本生成”监管讨论，直接催生 2023 年 EU AI Act 中“通用 AI 系统”分类。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
GPT-2 是 LLM 时代“AI 安全影响产品决策”的起点。
理解 GPT-2(2019,1.5B + 分阶段发布) → GPT-3(2020,175B + API 控制) → ChatGPT(2022,RLHF + 全量公开) → GPT-4(2023,多模态 + 红队测试）这条线，可看出 OpenAI 路线：从“谨慎发布”到“开放 API”到“消费级产品”的演化。
events.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2019) GPT-2 paper; OpenAI blog
events.card_summary_zh: GPT-2 展示连贯长文本生成能力，也因潜在滥用风险分阶段开放，模型发布第一次与安全治理正面相撞。
events.card_summary_en: GPT-2 demonstrated coherent long-form text generation but was released in stages due to potential misuse risks. This marked the first major collision between a foundation model release and AI safety governance.
events.summary_en: On February 14, 2019, OpenAI published the paper "Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners" alongside a blog post detailing GPT-2. The model featured a 48-layer Transformer decoder with 1.5 billion parameters and was trained on WebText, a 40GB dataset of 45 million webpages. GPT-2 demonstrated zero-shot capabilities across seven tasks, including translation, question answering, summarization, and creative writing. Citing risks of malicious use, OpenAI opted for a staged release strategy: debuting a 117M-parameter version in February, followed by 345M in May, 774M in August, and finally the complete 1.5B model in November 2019.
events.context_en: Lead-authored by Alec Radford, the GPT-2 paper bypassed traditional academic conferences and was published directly on OpenAI’s website. The staged release strategy represented OpenAI’s first instance of AI safety concerns directly dictating product rollout, a decision that ignited fierce debate within the AI community. Critics from organizations like AllenAI and Hugging Face dismissed the phased approach as a marketing stunt, while researchers from DeepMind and those who would later found Anthropic supported the cautious deployment. By September 2019, OpenAI shifted its internal stance, leading to the full model's release in November; subsequent models like GPT-3 abandoned the staged release approach. Broader than the technical achievement, GPT-2 triggered early regulatory discussions around text-based deepfakes and automated disinformation, directly influencing the eventual classification of "general-purpose AI systems" in the 2023 EU AI Act.
events.why_it_matters_en: GPT-2 established the precedent of AI safety considerations actively shaping foundation model deployment. Tracing OpenAI’s release trajectory reveals a distinct evolution in governance and commercialization: from GPT-2’s cautious, staged open-weight release in 2019, to GPT-3’s API-gated access in 2020, ChatGPT’s mass consumer rollout with RLHF in 2022, and GPT-4’s multimodal deployment following extensive red-teaming in 2023. This shift highlights the industry's broader transition from cautious open-weight experimentation to controlled API access and consumer-facing products.

events.title_zh: Lewis RAG:检索增强生成范式提出
events.title_en: Lewis RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigm Proposed
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 22 日，Facebook AI Research Patrick Lewis 等在 NeurIPS 2020 发表《Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks》（arXiv:2005.11401）。
RAG 用「检索器（Dense Passage Retrieval)+ 生成器（BART）」两阶段：检索器从知识库召回 top-k 文档，生成器基于检索文档生成答案。
RAG 在 OpenQA、Jeopardy QG、TriviaQA 上达到 SOTA,且知识库可热更新。
events.behind_scenes_zh:
RAG 一作 Patrick Lewis,FAIR 团队。
Lewis 2019-2020 基于 Karpukhin DPR(Dense Passage Retrieval)+ Lewis BART 提出 RAG。
RAG 论文 2020-05 发表,2022 年 ChatGPT 出现后 RAG 重新受关注:2023 年 LangChain、LlamaIndex、Pinecone、Weaviate 等公司围绕 RAG 构建 LLM 应用栈。
2024 年 RAG 成为 LLM 企业部署标准模式。
events.why_it_matters_zh:
RAG 是 LLM 时代知识接入的起点。
理解 RAG(2020) → RETRO(2021,DeepMind 7B 检索增强) → Toolformer(2023,工具调用) → ChatGPT Plugins(2023) → MCP(2024,Anthropic 模型上下文协议）这条线，可看出 LLM 知识接入演化：外挂检索 → 内嵌检索 → 工具调用 → 标准协议。
events.source_name: Lewis, P. et al. (2020) arXiv:2005.11401; NeurIPS 2020
events.card_summary_zh: RAG 让语言模型先检索外部知识再生成答案，为模型接入最新资料和私有数据提供了通用方法。
events.card_summary_en: By allowing language models to retrieve external knowledge before generating answers, RAG provided a universal method for integrating up-to-date information and private data.
events.summary_en: On May 22, 2020, Patrick Lewis and researchers at Facebook AI Research (FAIR) published "Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks" at NeurIPS 2020. The paper introduced RAG, a two-stage architecture combining a retriever (Dense Passage Retrieval) and a generator (BART). The retriever recalls the top-k relevant documents from a knowledge base, which the generator then uses to produce an answer. The researchers reported state-of-the-art results on benchmarks like OpenQA, Jeopardy QG, and TriviaQA, while demonstrating that the external knowledge base could be updated on the fly without retraining.
events.context_en: Patrick Lewis, the paper's lead author, developed the framework while working at Facebook AI Research (FAIR). Between 2019 and 2020, Lewis synthesized two existing technologies to create RAG: Karpukhin's Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) and his own prior work on the BART sequence-to-sequence model. Although the foundational paper was published in May 2020, the RAG paradigm experienced a massive resurgence in industry interest following the release of ChatGPT in late 2022. Throughout 2023, an extensive ecosystem of startups and open-source frameworks—including LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, and Weaviate—emerged specifically to build application stacks around RAG for large language models. By 2024, this architecture had firmly established itself as the standard deployment model for enterprise LLM applications.
events.why_it_matters_en: RAG marks the starting point for external knowledge integration in the era of large language models.
